books.unit: 常见冠词、情态动词、系动词与限定词

senses: art. 一（人、事、物）；任何一；每一
a.usage: an 用于以元音音素开始的词前

ex.en: A single decision by the board can affect thousands of employees.
ex.zh: 董事会的单个决定就可能影响数千名员工。

ex.en: The library opens at 8 a.m. on weekdays and at 9 a.m. on Saturdays.
ex.zh: 图书馆工作日早上八点开门，周六早上九点开门。

ex.en: An early start is essential if you want to avoid the morning traffic.
ex.zh: 如果想避开早高峰交通，早点出发是必要的。

abandon.usage: 【记】a+band（带子）+on→把带子解开→放弃【拓】abandoned a. 被遗弃的；辨析:abandon完全永远遗弃;desert违背诺言责任;discard抛弃无用物;forsake断绝情感依恋；v.抛弃，遗弃；离开，舍弃；放 弃 n.放任，放纵；拓展：abandon oneself to doing sth

ex.en: The most successful monarchies strive to abandon or hide their old aristocratic ways.
ex.zh: 最成功的君主国极力摒弃或隐藏他们昔日的贵族生活方式。

ex.en: The extended family have been abandoned in favor of isolated, two generation households.
ex.zh: 大家庭已经被抛弃，取而代之的是单门独户的两代人家庭。

ex.en: The Conservatives may abandon "off-plan" building.
ex.zh: 保守党可能会放弃期房。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 缩略,缩写;缩写形式

ex.en: 'UN' is the common abbreviation of 'the United Nations'.
ex.zh: UN 是 the United Nations（联合国）的常用缩写。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: v. 退位,逊位;失(职),放弃(职责)
abdicate.usage: v.退位；放弃(责任)，失(职)；ab（表示否定）+dic（说；命令）+ate（动词后缀）→不再命令→退位

ex.en: She was forced to abdicate the throne of Spain.
ex.zh: 她被迫让出西班牙的王位。

ex.en: Several historians argue that the king was compelled to abdicate in favour of his younger brother.
ex.zh: 几位历史学家认为，国王被迫退位，将王位让给了他的弟弟。

ex.en: Critics claim that the government has abdicated its responsibility to protect public health.
ex.zh: 批评人士称，政府已放弃其保护公众健康的职责。

senses: n. (昆虫、蜘蛛或甲壳类动物的)腹部

ex.en: The doctor pressed gently on the patient's abdomen to check for signs of pain.
ex.zh: 医生轻轻按压病人的腹部，检查是否有疼痛迹象。

ex.en: The police rescued a child who had been abducted from a busy shopping centre.
ex.zh: 警方营救了一名从繁忙购物中心被拐走的孩子。

ex.en: He was charged with aiding and abetting the escape of two prisoners.
ex.zh: 他被控协助并教唆两名囚犯越狱。

phrases.m: 遵守(法律等);信守(诺言等);忠于(某人)

abide.usage: 过去式/过去分词：abode/abided【拓】abiding a. 持久不变的；同义:endure,tolerate;助记:字母序abcde中c换成i即abide；v.遵守；容忍，忍受；联想字母表：bd中间应是c不是i，i不“遵守”字母顺序规则，所以产生abide这个词。；联想记忆：把 abcde 的 c 改成 i，

ex.en: The company, a major energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations.
ex.zh: 该公司是新英格兰地区的一个主要能源供应商,上周宣布要违反一项长期承诺,不再遵守佛蒙特州严格的核能法规,这激起了当地人们的强烈愤慨。

ex.en: Both sides promised to abide by the contract.
ex.zh: 双方承诺遵守合同。

phrases.p: to the best of one's ability

ex.en: Fluid intelligence is the type of intelligence that has to do with short-term memory and the ability to think quickly, logically, and abstractly in order to solve new problems.
ex.zh: 流体智力是一种与短期记忆以及快速、逻辑、抽象思维能力有关,以解决新问题为目标的智力。

ex.en: The test is designed to measure a child's ability to solve problems independently.
ex.zh: 这项测试旨在衡量儿童独立解决问题的能力。

ex.en: Modern technology has greatly expanded our ability to process vast amounts of data.
ex.zh: 现代技术极大地扩展了我们处理海量数据的能力。

senses: 表具有某种性质的，形容词词性
adj. 有能力的,能干的,显示出才华的
able.usage: 真:able men有才能的人；索引p402

ex.en: Only a handful of firms were able to survive the sudden economic downturn.
ex.zh: 只有少数公司能够在突如其来的经济衰退中生存下来。

ex.en: She proved herself an able administrator during her years in office.
ex.zh: 在任职期间，她证明了自己是一位能干的管理者。

ex.en: Students from poorer families are less able to afford expensive private tutoring.
ex.zh: 贫困家庭的学生较难负担昂贵的私人辅导。

senses: adj. 反常的,异常的,变态的
adj. 反常的，异常的，不正常的
abnormal.usage: ab(no 不)+norm(标准)+al(形容词后缀)→不标准的→反常的；反义:normal;irregular无规律;unusual少有奇特;odd古怪;abnormal偏离正常而反常；adj.反常的，异常的；ab（否定）+norm（标准）+al（形容词后缀）→不标准的，就是“反常的”。

ex.en: The accidents were due to abnormal weather conditions.
ex.zh: 事故是由于异常的天气情况造成的。

ex.en: Doctors warned that the patient's body temperature remained abnormal for several days.
ex.zh: 医生警告说，病人的体温连续几天都不正常。

ex.en: What appears abnormal in one culture may be perfectly acceptable in another.
ex.zh: 在一种文化中显得反常的行为，在另一种文化中可能完全可以接受。

senses: prep. 在(船、飞机、火车等)上
aboard.usage: a(on在……上)+board(甲板)→在甲板上→在船上;All aboard!各位,请上车(船、飞机)!；a（一个）+board（板子）→登船的时候，需要通过一个板子→上船。

ex.en: Welcome aboard!
ex.zh: 欢迎登机！

ex.en: The new government promised to abolish the outdated tax and simplify the whole system.
ex.zh: 新政府承诺废除这一过时的税种，简化整个税制。

senses: vt. 废止,废除(法律,制度,习俗等)
v. 废除，废止（法律、制度、习俗等）
vt. 废除，取消（法律、制度等）
vt. 废除（法律、制度、习俗等）
abolish.usage: 辨析:abolish废除法律制度习俗;cancel取消撤销;反义:establish;派生:abolition废除；ab（表示否定）+ol+ish（表示使……）→使这个东西不要了→废除；abolish 多指废除制度/法律；cancel 取消会议/订单。；索引p402

ex.en: This law abolished special educational requirements for federal jurors and required them to be selected at random from a cross section of the entire community.
ex.zh: 该法案废除了对联邦陪审员的特殊教育要求，并要求联邦陪审员要在社会各阶层的民众中随机挑选。

ex.en: The new government abolished the old tax system.
ex.zh: 新政府废除了旧的税收制度。

ex.en: The court's ruling on abortion rights sparked a heated nationwide debate.
ex.zh: 法院关于堕胎权的裁决在全国范围引发了激烈辩论。

ex.en: The rebels' abortive coup lasted less than twenty-four hours.
ex.zh: 叛军的未遂政变持续了不到二十四小时。

abound.usage: v.大量存在；发音类似“啊棒的”→这里到处都是玩具，对于小朋友来说是很棒的→大量存在。；词根记忆：ab(表强调)+o+und(wave, 涌现的人或物)→涌现出很多人或物→大量存在；索引p402

ex.en: Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take. Opportunities for misinterpretation, error, and self-deception abound.
ex.zh: 先前的知识和兴趣影响着我们的经历以及对自己经历的解读,还影响着我们随后采取的行动。误解、错误和自我欺骗随处可见。

ex.en: As the economy picks up, opportunities will abound for aspiring leaders.
ex.zh: 随着经济的复苏，有抱负的领导人将获得大量机会。

ex.en: Opportunities for misinterpretation, error, and self-deception abound.
ex.zh: 误解、差错和自我欺骗的机会无处不在。

senses: adv. 在周围,附近,到处,大约

ex.en: The lecture is about how artificial intelligence is changing the job market.
ex.zh: 这个讲座是关于人工智能如何改变就业市场的。

senses: prep. 在……上面(但不接触)；超过,高于
adv. 在上面(但不接触)；高于

ex.en: The temperature stayed above thirty degrees for the third consecutive day.
ex.zh: 气温连续第三天保持在三十度以上。

abroad.usage: at home and abroad 国内外;spread abroad 到处流传；adv.在国外，到国外；广 为流传；索引p402

ex.en: More and more young people choose to study abroad to broaden their horizons.
ex.zh: 越来越多的年轻人选择出国留学以开阔视野。

ex.en: The company plans to expand its business abroad next year.
ex.zh: 该公司计划明年将业务拓展到国外。

ex.en: Rumours that the minister would resign soon spread abroad.
ex.zh: 部长即将辞职的传闻很快传开了。

senses: a. （言语、行为）唐突的，莽撞的
adj. (举止、言谈等)唐突的,鲁莽的
adj. 突然的；唐突的；生硬的
abrupt.usage: [记] ab-（加强意义）+rupt（打断）。[族] abruptly ad. 突然地。[近] sudden a. 突然的；ab(向)+rupt(打破)→一下子打破→突然的;派生abruption n.突然的断裂(或分裂)；词根记忆: ab(away, 远离)+rupt(break, 断裂)→一下子因远离而断裂→突然的

ex.en: The meeting came to an abrupt end when the fire alarm sounded.
ex.zh: 火警响起时，会议突然中断了。

ex.en: His abrupt manner often offended colleagues who did not know him well.
ex.zh: 他唐突的举止常常冒犯那些与他不熟的同事。

ex.en: The meeting ended abruptly when the fire alarm sounded through the building.
ex.zh: 火警铃声在大楼里响起时，会议突然结束。

absence.usage: 反义:presence 在场,出席；n.缺席，缺勤，不在；缺乏；索引p402

ex.en: Her absence from the meeting was noticed immediately by the chairperson.
ex.zh: 主席立刻注意到了她缺席会议。

ex.en: In the absence of solid evidence, the court dismissed the case.
ex.zh: 由于缺乏确凿证据，法院驳回了此案。

ex.en: Repeated absence from school can seriously damage a child's academic progress.
ex.zh: 反复缺课会严重损害孩子的学业进步。

senses: adj. 漫不经心的,茫然的
adj. 缺席的；不存在的；心不在焉的
absent.usage: 反义:present 在场的,出席的；adj.缺席的；缺乏的；心不在 焉的 prep.缺乏，没有 v.缺席，离开；adj.缺席的；缺乏的；心不在 焉的 v.缺席，离开；ab(表示否定)+sent(存在)→不存在的→缺席的

ex.en: Three senior managers were absent from the annual general meeting.
ex.zh: 三位高级管理人员缺席了年度股东大会。

ex.en: Confidence was entirely absent from his performance in the final round.
ex.zh: 他在决赛轮的表现完全缺乏自信。

ex.en: She gave an absent reply, clearly thinking about something else.
ex.zh: 她心不在焉地回答，显然在想着别的事情。

senses: adv. 心不在焉地；出神地

phrases.p: stare absently into the middle distance
phrases.m: 心不在焉地盯着不远处

ex.en: He absently stirred his coffee while listening to the news on the radio.
ex.zh: 他一边听收音机里的新闻，一边心不在焉地搅着咖啡。

senses: adj. 纯粹的,完全的,十足的,绝对的
adj. 不受任何限制(或约束)的
adj. 无疑的,肯定的,确实的
adj. 绝对的；完全的；明确的
absolute.usage: absolute无比较级,不受very修饰,可用nearly修饰;派生:absolutely完全地；adj.完全的；绝对的，无疑的 n.绝对真理 本书的这个segment 谈到我们要switch 思路，在adulthood 的世界里，没有朋友，只有acquaintance。；adj.绝对的，无疑的 n.绝对真理；词根记

ex.en: France has decided its fashion industry has lost an absolute right to define physical beauty for women.
ex.zh: 法国已决定其时尚产业已经失去了定义女性体型美的绝对权力。

ex.en: In fact, these commutes were reportedly more enjoyable compared with those without communication, which makes absolute sense, if human beings thrive off of social connections.
ex.zh: 实际上，据反映，同全程无交流的旅途相比，这种（指同别人谈话的）行程更有趣，这是绝对有道理的，因为人类正是通过社交才能够不断发展。

ex.en: There is no absolute standard for judging artistic value, and critics often disagree about which works deserve lasting attention.
ex.zh: 评判艺术价值没有绝对的标准，评论家们常常对哪些作品值得长久关注意见不一。

absolutely.usage: adv.绝对地，完全地；当然；索引p402

ex.en: Training is absolutely essential in this business.
ex.zh: 在这个行业中，培训是绝对必要的。

ex.en: It is absolutely impossible to finish such a complicated project within a week.
ex.zh: 在一周内完成如此复杂的项目是绝对不可能的。

ex.en: Without clear goals, hard work alone is absolutely insufficient.
ex.zh: 缺乏明确目标，仅靠努力是绝对不够的。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. (尤指被认为错误的)绝对主义,绝对论
adj. 专制的；绝对主义的
n. 专制主义者；绝对论者

ex.en: The historian describes the country's eighteenth-century rulers as absolutist monarchs with unlimited power.
ex.zh: 这位历史学家将该国十八世纪的统治者描述为拥有无限权力的专制君主。

senses: vt. 吸引...的注意;占去(时间,注意力等)
vt. 吸进,吸收(液体,气体等)
absorb.usage: ab-(离开)+sorb(吸)→吸走→吸收；[族] absorption n. 吸收；派生:absorbing极有趣的;absorption吸收;辨析:be absorbed in专心于;be absorbed by为...所吸引；v.吸收；理解，掌握；使全神 贯注，使专心；承受；索引p402

ex.en: I never feel overwhelmed with the amount of information my brain absorbs.
ex.zh: 我从来不会因为大脑吸收的信息量庞大而感到难以承受。

ex.en: The climate change we are hastening could one day leave us with forests that emit more carbon than they absorb.
ex.zh: 人类活动导致的气候变化迟早有一天会使森林的碳排放量超过其吸收量。

ex.en: Small firms often struggle to absorb the rising costs of raw materials without raising prices for their customers.
ex.zh: 小公司往往难以在不向顾客提价的情况下消化原材料成本的上涨。

senses: n. 吸收；并入；专心致志

ex.en: The small intestine is responsible for the absorption of nutrients from digested food.
ex.zh: 小肠负责吸收消化后食物中的营养物质。

senses: n. (书,文,案情等的)摘要,梗概
abstract.usage: 同义:vague,summary,outline,remove,erase;反义:concrete具体;派生:abstraction抽象概念；adj.抽象的，纯概念的；抽象派 的 n.摘要，梗概；抽象派艺术作 品 v.使分离；写……的摘要；ab（表示“强调”）+s+tract（拽，拉）→重复地拽、拉→提取，提炼。；词根

ex.en: He wrote an abstract of a long article.
ex.zh: 他为一篇长文章写了摘要。

ex.en: But they were popular because of their airy glass walls, the views they afforded and the elegance of the buildings' details and proportions, the architectural equivalent of the abstract art so popular at the time.
ex.zh: 但它们（这些房子）却大受欢迎，因为它们拥有通透的玻璃墙和绝佳的视野景观，建筑细节和比例设计巧妙，是当时流行的抽象艺术在建筑上的体现。

ex.en: For young children, ideas such as justice and freedom remain too abstract to grasp without concrete examples.
ex.zh: 对幼儿而言，正义与自由这类概念仍然过于抽象，没有具体的例子就难以理解。

ex.en: It is easy to discuss fairness abstractly, but far harder to apply it in practice.
ex.zh: 抽象地谈论公平很容易，但在实践中践行公平却难得多。

senses: adj. 荒谬的，荒唐的，怪诞不经的
absurd.usage: 同义:foolish,ridiculous;派生absurdism n.荒诞主义;absurdity n.荒谬,荒唐,荒诞；ab（一再地）+surd（发音类似“笑”）→一再地笑→可笑的，荒谬的。；索引p402

ex.en: That uniform makes the guards look absurd.
ex.zh: 警卫们穿着那种制服看起来怪模怪样的。

ex.en: It is absurd to expect employees to work twelve hours a day without extra pay.
ex.zh: 指望员工每天工作十二小时却没有加班费是荒谬的。

ex.en: The claim that the vaccine changes human genes sounds absurd to scientists.
ex.zh: 疫苗会改变人类基因的说法在科学家听来很荒唐。

ex.en: The regulations have become so complicated that obeying them is practically absurd.
ex.zh: 这些规定变得如此复杂，以至于遵守它们几乎成了荒诞的事。

ex.en: The region enjoys an abundance of natural resources, including oil and natural gas.
ex.zh: 该地区拥有丰富的自然资源，包括石油和天然气。

ex.en: The abundance of online information makes it hard to distinguish facts from opinions.
ex.zh: 网络信息泛滥，使人难以区分事实与观点。

ex.en: Rainforests are known for the abundance of species they support.
ex.zh: 雨林以其养育的丰富物种而闻名。

senses: a. 丰富的；大量的；充足的
adj. 丰富的,充分的,充裕的
adj. 大量的，充裕的，丰富的

phrases.p: an abundant supply of fresh water

abundant.usage: 【拓】abundance n. 丰富，充裕；[族]abundantly ad. 丰富地；大量地；[近]plentiful a. 丰富的；大量的；充足的；adj.大量的，丰富的，充足的；a（一）+bund（发音类似“帮的”）+ant（蚂蚁）→那一帮的蚂蚁是不是很多→大量的。；词根:ab(表强调)+und(wave涌现的人

ex.en: Here was abundant fuel and lumber.
ex.zh: 这里有丰富的燃料和木材。

ex.en: To ensure the future of mankind, it is crucial to explore our planet's abundant resources.
ex.zh: 为了确保人类的未来，开发地球丰富的资源至关重要。

ex.en: The region's abundant sunshine makes it an ideal place for solar power generation.
ex.zh: 该地区充足的阳光使其成为发展太阳能发电的理想之地。

ex.en: The report makes it abundantly clear that funding cuts will hurt rural schools most.
ex.zh: 报告再清楚不过地表明，经费削减对乡村学校的伤害最大。

senses: vt. 虐待,伤害；辱骂,毁谤
abuse.usage: ab(不)+use(使用)→不当使用→滥用;同义:misuse,mistreat,insult;派生abusive adj.满口脏话的,恶言谩骂的；ab（否定）+use（使用）→不好好使用→滥用；拓展：alcohol/drug abuse 酗酒/吸毒，child abuse 虐待儿童；索引p402

ex.en: He was arrested on charges of corruption and abuse of power.
ex.zh: 他因被控贪污腐化和滥用职权而遭逮捕。

ex.en: The report documents widespread abuse of elderly patients in care homes.
ex.zh: 报告记录了养老院中普遍存在的虐待老人的行为。

ex.en: Critics say the subsidy system is open to abuse by large landowners.
ex.zh: 批评人士说，补贴制度容易被大土地所有者滥用。

ex.en: The referee was suspended after video showed him directing abuse at a player.
ex.zh: 视频显示该裁判辱骂一名球员后，他被停职了。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: After a decade in industry, she returned to academia to teach engineering.
ex.zh: 在企业工作十年后，她重返学术界教授工程学。

senses: adj. 学术的；学校的；学习好的
academic.usage: academic study 学术研究;academic year 学年;academic discussion 学术讨论；adj.学术的；学业优秀的 n.大学教师，学者；aca（发音类似“挨个”）+dem（发音类似“点名”）+ic→这位“大学老师”一上课就开始挨个点名。；索引p402

ex.en: Maintaining high academic standards should be the priority of a responsible university.
ex.zh: 维持高水平的学术标准才是一个负责任的大学应当首先考虑的事情。

ex.en: And after going to school for 12 years, it doesn't feel natural to spend a year doing something that isn't academic.
ex.zh: 而且在上了12年的学之后，再花一年的时间去做与学习无关的事情总会让人感觉不太正常。

ex.en: Universities should value practical experience as much as academic achievement when evaluating their graduates.
ex.zh: 大学在评价毕业生时，应当像重视学业成绩一样重视实践经验。

ex.en: The school performs well academically, yet its sports facilities remain poor.
ex.zh: 这所学校学业成绩出色，但体育设施仍然简陋。

senses: n. 学院；研究院；学会；专科院校

phrases.p: the American Academy of Arts and Sciences

academy.usage: 拓展：Chinese Academy of Sciences 中国科学院。；索引p402

ex.en: She trained at the Royal Academy of Music.
ex.zh: 她在皇家音乐学院培训过。

ex.en: He was admitted to a military academy at the age of eighteen.
ex.zh: 他十八岁时考入了一所军事学院。

ex.en: The academy of sciences has published a report on climate change.
ex.zh: 该科学院发布了一份关于气候变化的报告。

phrases.p: accelerate the pace of global warming

accelerate.usage: 近义:promote促进;quicken加快速率;advance加快进程;反义:decelerate减速；ac（一再地）+cele（音似“赛了”）+rate（速度）→比赛中加速；词根记忆：ac(表加强)+celer(swift,速度)+ate(动词后缀)→使某物更快→（使）加速；索引p402

ex.en: Exposure to the sun can accelerate the ageing process.
ex.zh: 暴露在日光下会加快老化过程。

ex.en: The use of this little-known practice has accelerated in recent years, as colleges continue to do their utmost to keep students in school (and paying tuition) and improve their graduation rates.
ex.zh: 近年来，由于高等院校继续竭尽全力留住学生(并支付学费)，以及提高学生毕业率，这种鲜为人知的做法得到了广泛应用。

ex.en: The widespread use of smartphones has accelerated the decline of traditional print media.
ex.zh: 智能手机的普及加速了传统纸质媒体的衰落。

acceleration.usage: n.加速；加速能力；加速度；索引p402

ex.en: The car's smooth acceleration makes merging into highway traffic much safer.
ex.zh: 这辆车平稳的加速使汇入高速公路车流安全得多。

senses: n. 腔调,口音；重音(符号)

ex.en: She retained a strong Scottish accent although she had lived abroad for twenty years.
ex.zh: 尽管她在国外生活了二十年，仍带着浓重的苏格兰口音。

senses: vt. 接受；认可；接纳（为成员等）
accept.usage: 辨析:accept愿意接受/承认;receive只表示收到,未必赞同;派生:acceptable可接受的；v.接受；同意；认为……正确； 忍受；接纳；vt.接纳例为2013年完形；索引p402

ex.en: The scores were then used in conjunction with an applicant's score on the Graduate Management Admission Test, or GMAT, a standardised exam which is marked out of 800 points, to make a decision on whether to accept him or her.
ex.zh: 然后测评分数将与GMAT成绩共同决定某位申请者通过与否（GMAT即管理学研究生入学资格标准化考试，满分为800分）。

ex.en: Employers are increasingly willing to accept candidates without a traditional university degree.
ex.zh: 雇主们越来越愿意接受没有传统大学学位的求职者。

ex.en: It took her a long time to accept the fact that she had failed.
ex.zh: 她花了很长时间才接受自己失败的事实。

ex.en: Delaying the project by two weeks was the only acceptable solution for both parties.
ex.zh: 将项目推迟两周是双方唯一可接受的解决办法。

ex.en: Her humble acceptance of the award moved the audience, who rose to applaud her.
ex.zh: 她领奖时的谦逊感动了观众，观众起立为她鼓掌。

senses: n. 接近,进入;接近(或进入)的机会
n. 享用机会;入口,通道
vt. 存取,访问(计算机文件)
n. 通道，入口；机会（或权利）
access.usage: 派生:accessible adj.易接近的,可得到的；n.入口，通道；使用权 v.进入；访问；n.入口，通道；使用权 v.接近，进入；访问；ac（加强）+cess（走，前进）→一再地向前走→接近；①n.权利(2020年阅读) ②vt.访问电脑信息(2013年完形):We often hear media report

ex.en: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.
ex.zh: 官员接见中存在的“偏袒行为”会煽动公众的腐败感知。

ex.en: The most drastic, and thoroughly illegal, reaction has been the emergence of Sci-Hub, a kind of global photocopier for scientific papers, set up in 2012, which now claims to offer access to every paywalled article published since 2015.
ex.zh: （面对科学出版的现状）最激烈也完全非法的反应当属创立于2012年的Sci-Hub(一个类似全球科技论文影印机的数据库)，目前其声称可供人访问自2015年以来发表的每一篇付费阅读论文。

ex.en: Rural residents often lack easy access to the specialist medical care available in large cities.
ex.zh: 农村居民往往难以便捷地获得大城市所拥有的专科医疗服务。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 易接近,易使用;可及性,可达性,可接入性
n. 可获得性；可（易）接近性

ex.en: The city has improved the accessibility of public transport for wheelchair users.
ex.zh: 该市改善了公共交通对轮椅使用者的可及性。

ex.en: Improving the accessibility of higher education remains a central goal of the reform.
ex.zh: 提高高等教育的可及性仍是这项改革的核心目标。

ex.en: Website accessibility standards require that pages be usable by people with disabilities.
ex.zh: 网站无障碍标准要求网页对残障人士同样可用。

senses: adj. 易接近的；可进入的；可使用的；易懂的
adj. 可接近的；可使用的；浅显易懂的
accessible.usage: adj.可接近的；词根:access(接近)+ible(可…的)→可接近的；索引p402

ex.en: The museum has made its collections accessible to the public through online databases.
ex.zh: 该博物馆通过在线数据库向公众开放其藏品。

ex.en: The professor is known for presenting complex theories in a way accessible to beginners.
ex.zh: 这位教授以初学者易懂的方式讲解复杂理论而闻名。

ex.en: The village is accessible only by boat during the rainy season.
ex.zh: 雨季时，这个村庄只能乘船到达。

senses: n. 附件,配件;附属物;从犯

ex.en: The store sells phone cases, chargers, and other accessories at discounted prices.
ex.zh: 这家店以折扣价出售手机壳、充电器和其他配件。

accident.usage: 辨析:accident偶发事故;incident不太重要的事件;event重大事件;occurrence/happening日常事件；词根记忆: ac(near, 附近)+cid(fall, 落)+ent(形容词后缀)→从旁边落下来的→意外；索引p402

ex.en: The highway was closed for hours after a serious accident involving two trucks.
ex.zh: 一起涉及两辆卡车的严重事故发生后，高速公路关闭了数小时。

ex.en: Investigators concluded that the fire was accidental rather than deliberate.
ex.zh: 调查人员断定火灾属于意外，并非人为蓄意。

ex.en: She accidentally deleted the file, but a backup copy saved the project.
ex.zh: 她不小心删除了文件，但一个备份副本挽救了这个项目。

senses: ②(尤指对艺术成就的)称誉，高度评价
acclaim.usage: hail 的近义词；同义 praise；v.赞扬，称赞 n.赞扬，称誉；ac（一再地）+claim（说，喊）→一再地说，一再地喊，干什么呢？→公开称誉；词根记忆：ac(表加强)+claim(shout，叫喊)→一再呼喊→为…喝彩；词根claim：to shout叫喊；索引p402

ex.en: The work was acclaimed as a masterpiece.
ex.zh: 该作品被誉为杰作。

ex.en: At any rate, this change will ultimately be acclaimed by an ever-growing number of both domestic and international consumers, regardless of how long the current consumer pattern will take hold.
ex.zh: 无论如何，这一变化最终将受到越来越多的国内和国际消费者的称赞，无论当前的消费模式会持续多长时间。

ex.en: The young director won international acclaim for a film that explored the lives of migrant workers.
ex.zh: 这位年轻导演因一部探讨外来务工人员生活的电影而赢得国际赞誉。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 适应环境(气候、水土等)
n. 适应（环境、条件、气候等）
acclimation.usage: 词根:ac(to)+clim(slope倾斜)+ation(名词后缀)→向某事物倾斜→适应；索引p402

ex.en: Gap year experiences can lessen the blow when it comes to adjusting to college and being thrown into a brand new environment, making it easier to focus on academics and activities rather than acclimation blunders.
ex.zh: 间隔年的经历会减轻（学生）适应大学和身处一个全新环境时遭受的打击，让他们更容易把精力集中在学业和各种活动上而不是适应过程中犯的错上。

senses: vt. ①使适应，使符合一致
②调和(分歧等) ③帮助，给……提供方便
④向……提供住处(或膳宿) ⑤容纳，接纳
v. 为……提供住宿；容纳；适应

phrases.m: 改变以适应(新情况)，使符合一致

phrases.p: accommodate this new world of people in motion
phrases.m: 适应这样一个人口流动的新世界

accommodate.usage: 派生 accommodating adj. (乐于)帮助的；v.为……提供住宿；容纳，提供 空间；适应；迎合；千里迢迢来送货（commodity），总得给他提供住宿（accommodate）。；索引p402

ex.en: The hotel can accommodate up to 500 guests.
ex.zh: 这家旅馆可供多达500位旅客住宿。

ex.en: The new railway timetable was adjusted to accommodate the growing number of commuters in the suburbs.
ex.zh: 新的列车时刻表经过调整，以满足郊区日益增多的通勤者的需要。

ex.en: Schools must accommodate students with different learning styles rather than forcing them into a single mold.
ex.zh: 学校必须照顾学习方式各异的学生，而不是把他们强塞进同一个模子。

senses: n. 住处；膳宿；办公处；停留处

ex.en: The university guarantees first-year students accommodation in halls near the main campus.
ex.zh: 大学保证为一年级学生提供主校区附近宿舍的住宿。

ex.en: The singer performed the old folk song with a simple guitar accompaniment.
ex.zh: 歌手在简单的吉他伴奏下演唱了这首古老的民歌。

accompany.usage: 【拓】accompaniment n. 伴奏；派生 accompaniment n. 伴随发生(或存在)的事物；伴奏，伴唱；他陪伴accompany公司company的领导出席宴会；索引p402

ex.en: The text is accompanied by a series of stunning photographs.
ex.zh: 正文附有一系列令人惊叹的照片。

ex.en: Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed.
ex.zh: 复制和确认人们已经知晓和相信的知识几乎不会带来什么回报。

ex.en: Children must be accompanied by an adult when visiting the laboratory.
ex.zh: 儿童参观实验室时必须由成人陪同。

ex.en: Strong winds accompanied the heavy rain that swept the coastal town.
ex.zh: 狂风伴随着席卷沿海小镇的暴雨。

ex.en: The accompanying charts illustrate the steady rise in household debt since 2010.
ex.zh: 随附的图表显示了自2010年以来家庭债务的持续上升。

senses: vt. ①达到(目的)，完成(任务)，实现(计划、诺言等)
accomplish.usage: 【拓】accomplishment n. 成就；辨析：accomplish 强调结果；complete 指工程等完整终结；finish 最常用；派生 accomplishment n. 技能；v.完成，实现；辨:强调完成的过程和结果，或强调完成过程中的熟练技巧等；索引p402

ex.en: Universal history, the history of what man has accomplished in this world, is at bottom the History of the Great Men who have worked here.
ex.zh: 世界历史就是人类在这个世界上取得的成就的历史，实质上也就是在世界上活动的伟人的历史。

ex.en: On their own, taking our own bags to the grocery store or quitting plastic straws, for example, will accomplish little and require very little of us.
ex.zh: 凭个人的力量，比如说，在我们去杂货店的时候自带袋子，或者停止使用塑料吸管，将会收效甚微而且对我们的要求也很低。

ex.en: It is far easier to set ambitious goals than to accomplish them through sustained daily effort.
ex.zh: 树立宏伟目标，远比通过持之以恒的日常努力去实现它们要容易。

senses: adj. 熟练的，技艺高超的

ex.en: Sarah had become accomplished at running the house.
ex.zh: 萨拉已能老练地操持家务了。

ex.en: Finishing the marathon was a great accomplishment for someone who once feared exercise.
ex.zh: 对于一个曾经害怕运动的人来说，跑完马拉松是一项巨大的成就。

ex.en: The construction of the bridge was regarded as a remarkable engineering accomplishment.
ex.zh: 这座桥的建造被视为一项了不起的工程成就。

ex.en: She felt a deep sense of accomplishment after publishing her first book.
ex.zh: 出版第一本书后，她感到了深深的成就感。

accord.usage: in accord with 与……一致（或相符合）；in accordance with 按照，依据；联想记忆：ac(表加强)+cord(绳索)→拧成一股绳→与…一致；索引p402

ex.en: The two sides signed a peace accord last July.
ex.zh: 在刚过去的七月，双方签订了和平条约。

ex.en: Since desire and will are damaged by the presence of thoughts that do not accord with desire, Allen concluded: "We do not attract what we want, but what we are."
ex.zh: 由于愿望和意志会因为同愿望背道而驰的思想的存在而受到损害，艾伦得出如下结论："我们吸引什么取决于我们自身而不是我们所求。"

ex.en: Employees are paid in accordance with their experience and professional qualifications.
ex.zh: 员工的薪酬是按照其资历和专业资格来确定的。

senses: prep. 据（……所说）；依照；按照；根据

ex.en: People complained that buses were late and infrequent. So, the number of buses and bus lanes were increased, and drivers were rewarded or punished according to the time they took.
ex.zh: 人们抱怨公交车晚点且班次少。因此，公交车和公交车专用道的数量增加了，而且司机们会依照他们（路上）所花的时间被奖励或惩罚。

ex.en: As the economy develops, the living conditions of the people have been improved accordingly.
ex.zh: 随着经济的发展，人民的生活水平也提高了。

senses: ②(of)描述，叙述；v. ①认为，视为
②(for)说明，解释 ③(for)占(一定数量或比例)
account.usage: 另 by/from all accounts 据说，根据报道；派生 accountable adj. 有责任的；n.账户；账目；解释 v.认为；词根记忆：ac(表加强)+count(计算)→计算账目→账户；账目；③vi.(~for)（数量、比例上）占，2018年阅读：personnel accounts for 80

ex.en: Many, like the Fundamental Physics Prize, are funded from the telephone-number-sized bank accounts of Internet entrepreneurs.
ex.zh: 很多奖项的资金，如基础物理学奖，都来自互联网企业家那些拥有巨额存款的银行账户。

ex.en: In dealing with the Supreme Court decision Thursday, the author gives a factual account of it and discusses its consequences.
ex.zh: 针对美国最高法院周四做出的一项裁决，作者对其做出了事实描述，并讨论了其后果。

ex.en: Poor families account for a growing share of the students dropping out of university.
ex.zh: 在大学辍学学生中，贫困家庭出身者所占比例越来越大。

ex.en: The poor weather may have accounted for the small crowd.
ex.zh: 天气不好可能是人来得少的原因。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. [U] （对自己的决定、行为）负有责任，有说明义务

ex.en: The reform is designed to strengthen the accountability of senior managers.
ex.zh: 这项改革旨在加强高级管理人员的问责制。

ex.en: Public officials must accept accountability for the failure of the project.
ex.zh: 公共官员必须为该项目的失败承担责任。

ex.en: Greater transparency in public spending improves accountability to taxpayers.
ex.zh: 公共支出更加透明可以增强对纳税人的问责。

senses: adj. 对…负有责任的；可解释的

ex.en: The main purpose of this "clawback" rule is to hold bankers accountable for harmful risk-taking and to restore public trust in financial institutions.
ex.zh: 这项“奖金延迟支付”规定的主要目的是让银行家为不利的冒险行为负责，以及恢复公众对金融机构的信任。

senses: n. 会计(员)，会计师；账房，出纳
accountant.usage: n.会计，会计师；account(账目)+ant(人)→打理账目的人→会计

ex.en: She has been an accountant all her working life.
ex.zh: 她在整个职业生涯中一直是会计师。

ex.en: The accountant discovered several errors in the company's annual financial report.
ex.zh: 会计在公司年度财务报告中发现了几处错误。

ex.en: Small businesses often hire an accountant to handle their tax returns.
ex.zh: 小企业通常聘请会计师来处理纳税申报。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: v. 积累;(逐渐)增加,增多

ex.en: Interest will accrue on the loan if repayment is delayed beyond six months.
ex.zh: 如果还款延迟超过六个月，贷款将产生利息。

senses: v. 积累，积聚；逐渐增加
accumulate.usage: 记：ac-（加强意义）+cumul（积累）+-ate（动词后缀）→积累；辨析：accumulate 指长年累月积累；assemble 指把零散物或分散的人集合起来；gather 指自发集合；collect 收集；派生 accumulation n. 积累，堆积；ac(加强)+cumul(积累)+ate(动词后缀)→一直

ex.en: I seem to have accumulated a lot of books.
ex.zh: 我好像已经收集了很多书。

ex.en: Dust had accumulated on every surface of the abandoned house.
ex.zh: 这座废弃房子的每个表面积满了灰尘。

ex.en: The pension fund allows employees to accumulate savings for retirement.
ex.zh: 该养老基金让员工能够为退休积累储蓄。

ex.en: Evidence has accumulated that regular exercise slows cognitive decline.
ex.zh: 越来越多的证据表明，经常锻炼能减缓认知衰退。

phrases.p: the accumulation of body fat around the abdomen

ex.en: The accumulation of plastic waste in the oceans poses a serious threat to marine life.
ex.zh: 海洋中塑料垃圾的不断累积对海洋生物构成严重威胁。

accuracy.usage: ac-(加强)+cur(关心)+-acy→关心的结果处于精确状态→准确性；近precision，反inaccuracy；反义 inaccuracy n. 不准确；错误；n.精确性；准确，精确；索引p402

ex.en: Editors are responsible for checking the accuracy of every fact before the article goes to print.
ex.zh: 编辑有责任在文章付印前核实每一处事实的准确性。

ex.en: Weather forecasts have improved remarkably in accuracy over the past two decades.
ex.zh: 在过去二十年中，天气预报的准确性有了显著提高。

ex.en: The accuracy of the survey results depends heavily on how the questions are worded.
ex.zh: 调查结果的准确性在很大程度上取决于问题的措辞方式。

senses: adj. 准确的，正确无误的
adj. 正确无误的，精确的，准确的
accurate.usage: 辨析：accurate 与标准略有偏差或在允许范围内；exact 极准确，与范例一致；precise 精确的；反义 inaccurate 不精确的；adj.准确的，精确的；ac（加强）+cur（发音类似care“关心”）+ate（后缀）→一再关注就做得越精确。；索引p402

ex.en: I'm not convinced the reports are accurate.
ex.zh: 我不相信这些报道是准确的。

ex.en: The weather forecast is not always accurate, especially in mountainous regions.
ex.zh: 天气预报并不总是准确的，尤其是在山区。

ex.en: Journalists have a duty to report events in an accurate and balanced manner.
ex.zh: 记者有责任以准确、公正的方式报道事件。

ex.en: The new map provides an accurate picture of the city's transport network.
ex.zh: 新地图准确反映了该市的交通网络。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. [C,U] 控告；起诉；告发；谴责
n. 控告,起诉,告发;谴责

ex.en: He firmly denied the accusation that he had leaked the documents.
ex.zh: 他坚决否认了泄露文件的指控。

ex.en: The accusation of fraud damaged the firm's reputation almost overnight.
ex.zh: 欺诈指控几乎在一夜之间损害了这家公司的声誉。

ex.en: Without proof, such an accusation is nothing more than an insult.
ex.zh: 没有证据，这样的指责只是一种侮辱。

accuse.usage: [族] accusation n. 指控；[近] charge vt. 指控；辨析：accuse sb. of 指控；impeach 弹劾(for)；complain about 抱怨；charge sb. with 正式起诉；反义 defend 辩护；派生 accused n. 被告；accuser n. 原告；v.

ex.en: She accused him of lying.
ex.zh: 她指责他说谎。

ex.en: Still, we need to be careful not to accuse opponents of bad arguments too quickly.
ex.zh: 尽管如此，我们仍须谨慎行事，不要过快地指责对手的论点有多糟糕。

ex.en: Critics accuse the government of hiding the true cost of the infrastructure project.
ex.zh: 批评者指责政府隐瞒这项基础设施工程的真实成本。

accustom.usage: v.使习惯于，使适应于；索引p402

ex.en: It took her several months to accustom herself to the noise of the city.
ex.zh: 她花了好几个月才习惯这座城市的喧嚣。

ex.en: International students quickly become accustomed to local food and customs.
ex.zh: 国际学生很快便习惯了当地的食物和风俗。

ex.en: Born in a northern city, he is accustomed to long, cold winters.
ex.zh: 他出生在北方城市，早已习惯漫长寒冷的冬天。

ex.en: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests.
ex.zh: 州政府对森林治理驾轻就熟。

ex.en: State governments are well accustomed to managing forests, but traditionally they've focused on wildlife, watersheds and opportunities for recreation.
ex.zh: 州政府在管理森林方面已经驾轻就熟，但是传统上他们关注的是野生动植物、水域和重建的机会。

ache.usage: 合成:backache背痛,腰痛;heartache痛心;stomachache胃痛;toothache牙痛

ex.en: After moving the furniture all day, he felt a dull ache in his shoulders.
ex.zh: 搬了一整天家具后，他感到肩膀隐隐作痛。

senses: vt. 实现；（尤指经过努力）取得，达到
v. ①(凭长期努力)达到(某目标、地位、标准)
achieve.usage: attain 的近义词；派生achievement n.成就；完成；成绩；辨:表示经过一番不懈的努力，最终达到预定目标，取得成功或胜利；索引p402

ex.en: Sooner or later our shared efforts will achieve results.
ex.zh: 我们的共同努力迟早会取得成果。

ex.en: The engineering team finally achieved its goal of cutting costs by ten percent.
ex.zh: 工程团队最终实现了将成本降低百分之十的目标。

ex.en: Few students achieve top grades without years of sustained effort.
ex.zh: 很少有学生不经过多年持续努力就能取得顶尖成绩。

ex.en: She achieved international recognition for her research on sleep disorders.
ex.zh: 她因对睡眠障碍的研究获得了国际认可。

achievement.usage: n.成绩，成就；完成，实现；索引p402

ex.en: This is the gap that must be narrowed to close the achievement gap.
ex.zh: 这正是弥合成就差距所必须缩小的缺口。

ex.en: Winning the Nobel Prize was the crowning achievement of her scientific career.
ex.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖是她科学生涯的最高成就。

ex.en: Teachers should praise children's efforts rather than focus solely on their achievements.
ex.zh: 教师应当赞扬孩子的努力，而不应只关注他们的成绩。

ex.en: The program aims to make every child a confident achiever rather than a passive learner.
ex.zh: 该计划旨在让每个孩子都成为自信的成功者，而非被动的学习者。

ex.en: Acid rain has severely damaged large areas of forest in recent decades.
ex.zh: 近几十年来，酸雨对大片森林造成了严重破坏。

ex.en: The ending '-acity' appears in nouns of quality such as 'capacity' and 'audacity'.
ex.zh: 词尾 -acity 出现在 capacity（容量）、audacity（大胆）等表性质的名词中。

senses: vt. 承认；致谢；告知已收到
vt. 承认；告知已收到；答谢
vt. 承认；致谢；告知收到
acknowledge.usage: 【拓】acknowledgement n. 承认；感谢；派生 acknowledged adj. 公认的；acknowledg(e)ment n. 承认；致谢；v.承认；告知收到；感谢；acknowledge doing sth 承认做某事（不接 to do）；acknowledgement n. 承认，感谢。；vt.

ex.en: He acknowledged that the plan had failed.
ex.zh: 他承认计划失败了。

ex.en: What we need to do is find a way to acknowledge and express what we feel appropriately, and then—again, like children—move on.
ex.zh: 我们需要做的是找到一种能够适当地承认和表达我们感受的方式，然后，再像孩子那样——继续生活。

ex.en: The government has finally acknowledged the true scale of the housing shortage.
ex.zh: 政府终于承认了住房短缺的真实规模。

ex.en: The authors acknowledge the financial support of the national science foundation.
ex.zh: 作者们对国家科学基金会的资助表示感谢。

ex.en: The ending '-acle' appears in nouns such as 'miracle' and 'particle'.
ex.zh: 词尾 -acle 出现在 miracle（奇迹）、particle（粒子）等名词中。

books.unit: 51 当你了解更多，会有更多选择；52 “选择”相关词汇

acquaint.usage: 典型真题:be acquainted with指认识、熟悉;accepted接受;admitted承认;admired羡慕；ac（表示“加强”）+quai（发音类似“怪”）+nt→中国有句老话叫“见怪不怪”，见得多了就“熟悉”了。

ex.en: Let me acquaint you with the facts.
ex.zh: 让我把事实告诉你。

ex.en: It does not take a lifelong acquaintance to pick up various software programs.
ex.zh: 学会各种软件程序并不需要花毕生的时间。

ex.en: New employees should acquaint themselves with the company's safety regulations.
ex.zh: 新员工应当熟悉公司的安全规章。

senses: n. [C]熟人；认识的人；泛泛之交
acquaintance.usage: acquaint(熟悉)+ance(名词后缀)→熟悉；n.相识的人；认识；了解；词根记忆: ac(表加强)+quaint(知道)+ance(名词后缀)→知道的人→熟人；索引p402

ex.en: Strangers are inherently unfamiliar to us, so we are more likely to feel anxious when communicating with them compared with our friends and acquaintances.
ex.zh: 陌生人与我们素不相识，因此与跟自己的朋友和熟人交流不同，同陌生人交流时我们很容易感到焦虑。

ex.en: He is not a close friend of mine, merely a business acquaintance.
ex.zh: 他不是我的密友，只是生意上的一位熟人。

ex.en: A working acquaintance with statistics is essential for students of economics.
ex.zh: 经济学专业的学生必须具备统计学的实用知识。

ex.en: I made her acquaintance at an academic conference in Geneva.
ex.zh: 我是在日内瓦的一次学术会议上结识她的。

acquire.usage: derive 的近义词。；【拓】acquisition n. 获得；收购；辨析：acquire 强调持续、缓慢地逐渐获得(知识、能力等)；obtain 强调经过努力获得所需的东西；secure 强调有把握地获得、达到；attain 得到、达到(后常接水平、速度、荣誉等抽象名词)；v.获得、取得；v.获得，得到；学到，习

ex.en: I would love to apply the newly acquired skills to a job that I enjoy.
ex.zh: 我想把新获得的技能应用到我喜欢的工作中。

ex.en: Each spouse retains whatever property he or she brought into the marriage, and jointly-acquired property is divided equally.
ex.zh: 夫妇双方在离婚后可保有其带入婚姻中的任何财产，婚后共同取得的财产则要平均分配。

ex.en: Children acquire language most rapidly when they are surrounded by patient speakers.
ex.zh: 当周围的人耐心与之交谈时，儿童习得语言的速度最快。

senses: n. 获得；（知识、技能等的）习得；收购

ex.en: The acquisition of a second language becomes harder after childhood.
ex.zh: 童年之后，习得第二门语言变得更加困难。

ex.en: The company announced the acquisition of its main rival for two billion dollars.
ex.zh: 该公司宣布以二十亿美元收购其主要对手。

ex.en: The museum's latest acquisition is a rare collection of Ming porcelain.
ex.zh: 博物馆最新入藏的是一批罕见的明代瓷器。

ex.en: The firm became notably acquisitive, buying up smaller rivals across Europe.
ex.zh: 这家公司变得极热衷于收购，买下了欧洲各地的小型竞争对手。

ex.en: The jury took only two hours to acquit the defendant of all charges.
ex.zh: 陪审团仅用两个小时便裁定被告的所有罪名不成立。

ex.en: They bought an acre of land near the river to plant a small orchard.
ex.zh: 他们在河边买了一英亩土地，种了一片小果园。

ex.en: The acreage of farmland has declined steadily as cities continue to expand.
ex.zh: 随着城市不断扩张，农田面积持续减少。

acrobat.usage: acro（顶点，高点）+bat（打）→在高处表演打斗→杂技演员

ex.en: The acrobat could bend himself into a hoop.
ex.zh: 这个杂技演员可以把身体蜷曲成圆形。

ex.en: A new footbridge will be built across the river to connect the two districts.
ex.zh: 将在河上新建一座人行桥，连接两个城区。

ex.en: Because most of us believe that mind is separate from matter, we think that thoughts can be hidden and made powerless; this allows us to think one way and act another.
ex.zh: 因为大多数人相信，思想与物质是分离的，我们认为思维可以被隐藏并且不能起作用，这使得我们的思维和行为不一致。

action.usage: 【扩】act的名词形式。；另 out of action 使失去作用；go/come into action 开始战斗(行动)；put...in action 实行，付诸实施

ex.en: The government promised firm action against firms that mislead consumers in advertisements.
ex.zh: 政府承诺对在广告中误导消费者的公司采取坚决行动。

senses: v. 使激活，使活化，使(反应)加快；启动，开动，使活动
activate.usage: 辨析（形近）：contract 染上……病、订约；activate 使激活；maintain 保持、维持；prescribe 开处方；派生 activation n. 活性化，激活；v.激活，启动；索引p402

ex.en: Dawna Markova would most probably agree that curiosity activates creative minds.
ex.zh: 多娜·马尔科娃很可能同意好奇心激发创造性思维这一观点。

ex.en: Certain genes are activated only when the body is under stress.
ex.zh: 某些基因只有在身体承受压力时才会被激活。

ex.en: The alarm system is activated automatically when someone enters the building at night.
ex.zh: 夜间有人进入大楼时，警报系统会自动启动。

senses: a. 积极的；活跃的；有效的；起作用的
adj. 活跃的；积极的；现行的
active.usage: 派生 actively adv. 活跃地，积极地；activist n. 积极分子，活跃分子；索引p402

ex.en: As for me, weighing myself every day caused me to shift my focus from being generally healthy and physically active to focusing solely on the scale.
ex.zh: 就我自己而言，每天称体重使我将关注点从身体总体健康、精力旺盛这方面转移到只关注体重秤上的数字。

ex.en: Regular exercise keeps both the body and the mind active.
ex.zh: 经常锻炼能使身体和大脑都保持活跃。

ex.en: The volcano is still active and is monitored around the clock.
ex.zh: 这座火山仍然活跃，受到全天候监测。

ex.en: The charity actively encourages volunteers to design and propose their own projects.
ex.zh: 该慈善机构积极鼓励志愿者设计并提出自己的项目。

senses: n. [C] 积极分子；活跃分子

ex.en: The environmental activist addressed the crowd outside the parliament before the vote.
ex.zh: 表决前，这位环保积极分子在议会外向人群发表演讲。

ex.en: Regular physical activity significantly reduces the risk of heart disease in adults.
ex.zh: 经常进行体育锻炼能显著降低成年人患心脏病的风险。

ex.en: The young actor trained for two years to prepare for the role of a boxer.
ex.zh: 这位年轻演员为扮演拳击手一角训练了两年。

ex.en: The actress donated her prize money to a charity supporting rural schools.
ex.zh: 这位女演员把奖金捐给了资助乡村学校的慈善机构。

actual.usage: 派生 actually adv. 实际上；说实在地

ex.en: Their methods do not attempt to estimate the actual biomass.
ex.zh: 他们的方法不是尝试去估算实际的生物量。

ex.en: The actual cost of the project turned out to be far higher than estimated.
ex.zh: 该项目的实际成本最终远高于预算估计。

ex.en: In actual fact, few consumers noticed the change in packaging.
ex.zh: 事实上，几乎没有消费者注意到包装的变化。

ex.en: The new policy sounds generous, but actually it benefits only a small minority.
ex.zh: 新政策听起来慷慨，但实际上只惠及少数人。

senses: n. [U] （思维、视力、听力的）敏度，敏锐

ex.en: Age may weaken the body, but mental acuity can be preserved through reading and discussion.
ex.zh: 年龄或许会削弱体力，但通过阅读和交流可以保持思维的敏锐。

senses: a. （情况）严重的；（感觉）强烈的
a. 敏锐的；有洞察力的

phrases.m: 使某人的情感变得强烈

acute.usage: 记：acut（锋利的）+e→被锋利的刀刺伤后，情况危急的→严重的；同义 keen, smart, shrewd, sharp；反义 dull 迟钝的，不活泼的；一个（a）可爱的（cute）孩子，得了急性的疾病；真 face an acute crisis 面临一场严重的危机；索引p402

ex.en: As well as those chronic problems, the EU faces an acute crisis in its economic core, the 16 countries that use the single currency.
ex.zh: 除了这些长期的问题之外，欧盟的经济核心也面临着严重的危机：16个国家使用单一货币。

ex.en: Powerful memory doesn't make my emotions any more acute or vivid.
ex.zh: 强大的记忆力不会让我的情感更加敏锐或鲜明。

ex.en: Rural hospitals face an acute shortage of trained nurses.
ex.zh: 农村医院面临训练有素的护士严重短缺的问题。

ex.en: Owls have acute hearing that allows them to hunt in near darkness.
ex.zh: 猫头鹰听觉敏锐，能在近乎黑暗的环境中捕猎。

ex.en: Rural hospitals are acutely short of qualified nurses during the winter months.
ex.zh: 冬季几个月里，乡村医院极度缺乏合格的护士。

ex.en: The suffix '-acy' forms nouns of state or quality, such as 'privacy' and 'literacy'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -acy 构成表状态或性质的名词，如 privacy（隐私）、literacy（读写能力）。

ex.en: She answered an ad for a part-time job at the local bookshop.
ex.zh: 她应征了当地书店一则招聘兼职的广告。

senses: Anno Domini (=in the year of the Lord; since Christ was born)

ex.en: The ruined temple was built around 75 AD, during the Roman occupation.
ex.zh: 这座残破的神庙建于公元75年左右的罗马占领时期。

adapt.usage: adapt 适应；adopt 采纳。近义：adjust v. （调整以）适应；辨析：adapt 修改以适应；adjust 调整；fit 大小适合；suit 合要求；match 相配；反义 unfit；派生 adaptation；刚被收养(adopt)，但他适应（adapt）新家庭的速度很快。；adopt和adapt仅一

ex.en: You also quickly learn to adapt and come up with creative solutions to the problems the painting presents.
ex.zh: 你也能快速学会适应，并想出创造性的办法来解决绘画中出现的问题。

ex.en: It is not easy for old people to adapt to the fast pace of modern life.
ex.zh: 老年人不容易适应现代生活的快节奏。

ex.en: Part of the scientific community is trying to adapt its communication style.
ex.zh: 部分科学界人士正试图调整他们的沟通风格。

ex.en: But policies to help workers adapt will be indispensable.
ex.zh: 但是，帮助工人来适应（形势）的政策将必不可少。

ex.en: Successful species are usually highly adaptable to sudden changes in their environment.
ex.zh: 成功存续的物种通常对环境的突然变化有很强的适应能力。

ex.en: The film is a faithful adaptation of the classic novel, praised by critics and readers alike.
ex.zh: 这部电影是那部经典小说的忠实改编，评论界和读者都给予好评。

senses: adj. 有适应能力的；适应的
adaptive.usage: adj.适应的，有适应能力的；索引p402

ex.en: The software features an adaptive interface that changes according to each user's habits.
ex.zh: 该软件具有自适应界面，会根据每个用户的习惯而变化。

senses: vt. 增加；补充说；继续说；添加（特色）
add.usage: 另 add fuel to the flames 火上加油；v.添加；相加；增加；补充说， 继续说

ex.en: Add a little salt to the soup to improve its flavour.
ex.zh: 往汤里加一点盐来改善味道。

ex.en: She added that the new policy would benefit low-income families.
ex.zh: 她补充说，新政策将使低收入家庭受益。

ex.en: The new evidence only adds to the confusion surrounding the case.
ex.zh: 新证据只是加深了人们对这一案件的困惑。

senses: n. 吸毒成瘾的人；瘾君子
addict.usage: ad-(去)+dict(说)→不断被点名要说→欲罢不能→上瘾；[族] addicted a. 上瘾的；addiction n. 瘾；派生 addicted adj. 上瘾的；addiction n. 瘾；沉溺；addictive adj. 使人上瘾的；n.瘾君子；对……入迷的人 v.使上瘾，使沉迷；ad（表示加强）+d

ex.en: Many young boys become computer addicts.
ex.zh: 许多男孩子小小年纪就迷上了电脑。

ex.en: Recovering drug addicts need long-term support from society rather than punishment.
ex.zh: 正在戒毒的人需要的是社会的长期支持，而非惩罚。

ex.en: He became a shopping addict after losing his job, buying things he could hardly afford.
ex.zh: 失业后他成了购物成瘾的人，买些自己几乎负担不起的东西。

addicted.usage: 词根记忆: ad(表加强)+dict(命令)+ed→听从命令的→没有自主性的→成瘾的；索引p402

ex.en: Part of the problem is that many homeless adults are addicted to alcohol or drugs.
ex.zh: 部分问题是许多无家可归的成年人酗酒或吸毒成瘾。

ex.en: Millions of teenagers have become addicted to short videos on their smartphones.
ex.zh: 数百万青少年对智能手机上的短视频上瘾。

ex.en: He was addicted to computer games and rarely left his room.
ex.zh: 他沉迷于电脑游戏，很少离开自己的房间。

addiction.usage: 易混辨析: addiction强调药物上瘾，有害身体; obsession强调沉溺于某物、着迷痴迷; indulgence强调放纵的状态；索引p402

ex.en: Doctors warn that smartphone addiction among teenagers can harm sleep and concentration.
ex.zh: 医生警告说，青少年智能手机成瘾会损害睡眠和注意力。

senses: adj. 使人上瘾的；使人着迷的

ex.en: Health experts warn that sugary drinks can be highly addictive for children.
ex.zh: 健康专家警告，含糖饮料可能极易令儿童上瘾。

senses: n. 加法；增加；增加物；扩建部分

ex.en: All of these technologies are fairly recent additions.
ex.zh: 所有这些技术都是最近才加入的。

ex.en: In addition to regular salaries, employees receive annual bonuses.
ex.zh: 除固定工资外，员工还能获得年度奖金。

ex.en: The library's new wing is a recent addition to the campus.
ex.zh: 图书馆新楼是校园里新增的建筑。

senses: a. 附加的；额外的；外加的
adj. 附加的，另外的，额外的

ex.en: Additional social stresses may also occur because of the population explosion.
ex.zh: 由于人口激增，其他的社会压力也会产生。

ex.en: Passengers must pay an additional fee for each piece of heavy luggage.
ex.zh: 乘客每托运一件超重行李必须支付额外费用。

ex.en: The bridge project will require additional funding from private investors.
ex.zh: 大桥项目将需要私人投资者提供额外资金。

ex.en: Additional staff were hired to cope with the holiday shopping rush.
ex.zh: 为应对假日购物高峰又增雇了一些员工。

phrases.m: 把注意力集中于(某问题)

address.usage: 同义 speech；派生 addressee n. 收信人，收件人；辨析：常用于主观上觉得需要解决的问题，问题很有可能比较复杂；索引p402

ex.en: The threat of nationalisation may have been seen off for now, but it will return with a vengeance if the justified anger of passengers is not addressed in short order.
ex.zh: 国有化的威胁也许暂时可以避免，但是，如果乘客合理的愤怒不能马上得到解决的话，这种威胁将会卷土重来。

ex.en: The government must address the growing shortage of affordable housing.
ex.zh: 政府必须解决经济适用房日益短缺的问题。

ex.en: The manager will address the staff at this afternoon's meeting.
ex.zh: 经理将在今天下午的会议上向全体员工讲话。

ex.en: The suffix '-ade' appears in nouns such as 'lemonade' and 'blockade'.
ex.zh: 后缀 -ade 出现在 lemonade（柠檬水）、blockade（封锁）等名词中。

adept.usage: adj.熟练的，擅长的 n.能手，内行

ex.en: She is adept at solving problems under pressure, which has impressed her managers.
ex.zh: 她善于在压力下解决问题，这给经理们留下了深刻印象。

senses: adj. 足够的，充分的；恰当的
adj. 充分的，足够的，合格的

phrases.p: be adequate for/to...（be adequate to doing sth.）

adequate.usage: 近义：sufficient a. 足够的；反义：inadequate a. 不充分的；【拓】adequacy n. 足够；适当；[族]adequately ad. 充分地；[近]enough a. 足够的；adj.足够的，适当的，合乎需 要的；ad（加强）+equate（使等同）→相等的就是“充分的”；词根记忆: ad

ex.en: The room was small but adequate.
ex.zh: 房间虽小但够用。

ex.en: This is an adequate amount so long as it is aimed in the right direction.
ex.zh: 只要(这些基金)用对了方向，这一数额就是足够的。

ex.en: Many elderly people fail to receive adequate care because the relevant services are underfunded.
ex.zh: 由于相关服务资金不足，许多老年人得不到足够的照料。

senses: adv. 充分地；足够地；适当地

ex.en: Many schools are not adequately equipped to teach computer science.
ex.zh: 许多学校没有配备足够的设备来教授计算机科学。

senses: vi. 粘附，附着；坚持，遵循
adhere.usage: 派生adherence n.坚持,遵守;adherent n.信徒,拥护者/adj.粘着的；v.黏附，附着；遵循；ad（表示“加强”）+here（在这）→一直都在这儿→坚持。；adhere to 后接名词，不接不定式；adhesion n. 粘附。；词根记忆:ad(to,挨着)+her(stick,粘)→粘在某物上→紧

ex.en: There was oil adhering to the bird's feathers.
ex.zh: 鸟的羽毛上附着油。

ex.en: All members must adhere to the code of conduct.
ex.zh: 所有成员都必须遵守行为准则。

ex.en: For years executives and headhunters have adhered to the rule that the most attractive CEO candidates are the ones who must be poached.
ex.zh: 多年来，经理人以及猎头们都遵循这样的规则：最具有吸引力的首席执行官人选是那些需要去挖来的人。

ex.en: Strict adherence to safety procedures has reduced accidents in the factory by half.
ex.zh: 严格遵守安全程序使工厂事故减少了一半。

ex.en: The hotel offers rooms adjacent to the conference hall at a reduced rate.
ex.zh: 酒店以优惠价格提供会议厅旁边的房间。

ex.en: In English, an adjective usually comes before the noun it describes.
ex.zh: 在英语中，形容词通常位于它所修饰的名词之前。

adjoin.usage: ad(一再)+join(连接)→一再连接→紧挨；邻接

ex.en: Canada adjoins the United States.
ex.zh: 加拿大和美国接壤。

ex.en: The two families bought adjoining houses so that they could share a garden wall.
ex.zh: 这两家人买了相连的房子，这样他们可以共用一面花园围墙。

adjust.usage: ad-(去)+just(正确)→弄正确→调整；[族] adjustment n. 调整；记法：ad-（趋向）+just（公正）→不断修改使趋向公正→调整；adapt 的近义词；派生 adjustable adj. 可调节(整)的；adjustment n. 调节，调整；v.调整…以适应、适合；ad（表示“一再地”）+j

ex.en: But in the medium term, middle-class workers may need a lot of help adjusting.
ex.zh: 但是在发展中期，中产阶级的工人可能还需要很多外界帮助来适应这种变化。

ex.en: New employees usually need several months to adjust to the pace of the workplace.
ex.zh: 新员工通常需要几个月时间来适应职场节奏。

ex.en: You can adjust the height of the chair to protect your back during long hours of study.
ex.zh: 你可以调整椅子的高度，以免长时间学习时背部受伤。

senses: a. 可调整的；可调节的

ex.en: The clinic uses adjustable beds to keep patients comfortable during long treatments.
ex.zh: 诊所使用可调节的病床，让患者在长时间治疗中保持舒适。

adjustment.usage: adjust 的派生词；n.调整、调节；真题词组亦见：necessary adjustments 必要的调整；索引p402

ex.en: Moving to a new country requires a period of psychological adjustment.
ex.zh: 搬到新的国家需要一段心理调适期。

ex.en: The company made a minor adjustment to its pricing strategy.
ex.zh: 公司对其定价策略做了小幅调整。

ex.en: A slight adjustment of the schedule would allow more time for discussion.
ex.zh: 稍微调整一下日程就能留出更多讨论时间。

senses: v. 实施,执行,给予,投(药)
v. 管理；执行；给予；提供
administer.usage: ad（去，往）+minister（部长）→去当部长，“管理”部门，“执行”任务→管理，执行。；联想记忆：ad+minister(大臣)→大臣就是管理者→管理；索引p402

ex.en: The company's finances have been admirably administered.
ex.zh: 该公司的财务管理得很好。

ex.en: A special agency was set up to administer the disaster relief funds.
ex.zh: 成立了一个专门机构来管理救灾资金。

ex.en: The vaccine should be administered by trained medical staff.
ex.zh: 这种疫苗应由受过训练的医务人员接种。

ex.en: A new agency was set up to administrate the national health insurance scheme.
ex.zh: 政府设立了一个新机构来管理全国医疗保险计划。

senses: n. 管理；执行；行政部门；（尤指美国）政府
n. 管理；管理部门；（尤指美国）政府

ex.en: Many young Americans cast doubts on the administration's ability to handle information.
ex.zh: 许多美国年轻人对政府处理信息的能力表示怀疑。

ex.en: The new administration has promised to cut taxes for small businesses.
ex.zh: 新政府承诺为小企业减税。

ex.en: She holds a master's degree in business administration.
ex.zh: 她拥有工商管理硕士学位。

ex.en: The reform is intended to cut administrative costs in local government.
ex.zh: 这项改革旨在削减地方政府的行政开支。

senses: n. 管理人员，行政人员
n. 管理人员；行政人员

ex.en: The hospital administrator explained the new appointment system to the waiting patients.
ex.zh: 医院管理人员向候诊病人解释了新的预约制度。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: a. 可钦佩的；值得赞赏的；令人羡慕的
adj. 可钦佩的;值得赞赏的;令人羡慕的
adj. 令人钦佩的；值得赞赏的

ex.en: Her patience with difficult students is truly admirable.
ex.zh: 她对待难管教学生的耐心着实令人钦佩。

ex.en: The team made an admirable effort to finish the project ahead of schedule.
ex.zh: 团队为提前完成项目付出了值得赞赏的努力。

ex.en: It is admirable that he donates most of his income to charity.
ex.zh: 他把大部分收入捐给慈善机构，令人钦佩。

ex.en: Her calm handling of the crisis won the admiration of even her harshest critics.
ex.zh: 她对危机的沉着处理连最严厉的批评者也为之钦佩。

admire.usage: 派生 admirer n. 崇拜者，赞美者；admiring adj. 佩服的，羡慕的；v.钦佩，仰慕；欣赏，观赏

ex.en: I admire her determination to pursue science despite numerous obstacles.
ex.zh: 我钦佩她克服重重障碍追求科学的决心。

ex.en: Visitors from around the world come to admire the palace's architecture.
ex.zh: 世界各地的游客慕名而来，欣赏这座宫殿的建筑。

ex.en: We admire those who admit their mistakes and correct them promptly.
ex.zh: 我们赞赏那些承认错误并及时改正的人。

senses: n. 承认；允许进入；入场费
n. 准许加入；承认；入场费

phrases.p: apply for admission to a school

admission.usage: 辨析：admission 允许进入或加入、入场费门票(接 to)；admittance 许可进入、入场权；n.承认，供认；允许进入；拓展：Admission Free 免费入场；No Admittance 禁止入内；Admittance of Staff Members Only 仅限员工入内；索引p402

ex.en: The minister's resignation was an admission that she had lied.
ex.zh: 这位部长辞职等于承认她自己撒过谎。

ex.en: Admission to the gallery is free for children under six.
ex.zh: 美术馆对六岁以下儿童免费开放。

ex.en: Closing the village school was, in effect, an admission that the policy had failed.
ex.zh: 关闭乡村学校实际上等于承认这项政策已经失败。

ex.en: The university has raised its admission standards this year.
ex.zh: 这所大学今年提高了录取标准。

senses: v. 承认；准许进入；容纳
admit.usage: v.承认；准许进入；ad（去）+mit（=mitt，送，放行）→放行，放其进来→准许进入，容许，接收→承认；admit doing（不接 to do）；admission n. 承认；入场费。

ex.en: A large part of evaluation is calling out bad arguments, but we also need to admit good arguments by opponents and to apply the same critical standards to ourselves.
ex.zh: 评估的很大一部分是指出不好的论点，但我们也需要承认对手的好论点，并将同样的评判标准应用于我们自身。

ex.en: She admitted breaking the window.
ex.zh: 她承认打破了窗户。

ex.en: Even her strongest critics admit that the policy has reduced child poverty.
ex.zh: 即使她最严厉的批评者也承认，这项政策减少了儿童贫困。

ex.en: Many eating disorders begin in adolescence, when body image becomes a major concern.
ex.zh: 许多饮食失调始于青春期，那时身体形象成为主要担忧。

senses: adj. 青少年的,青春期的
n. (大约13到17岁之间的)青少年
adj. 青春期的；青少年的
adolescent.usage: ad(为了)+olesc(grow up长大)+ent→为了长大的→青少年的；发音类似“爱斗lesson”→想一想，谁爱和课程斗争呢？谁爱挑战课程呢？那肯定是学生，也就是青少年→青少年。；联想记忆: adole(adult, 成年人)+scent(气息)→散发着成年人的气息→将要成年→青少年；索引p402

ex.en: Chewing gum, once bought primarily by adolescent boys, is now featured in commercials as a breath freshener and teeth cleanser for use after a meal.
ex.zh: 曾经主要是青春期的男孩购买的口香糖，现在在商业广告中被描述为饭后使用的口气清新剂和牙齿清洁剂。

ex.en: Many adolescents spend several hours a day interacting on social media.
ex.zh: 许多青少年每天花数小时在社交媒体上互动。

ex.en: The study examines how adolescent brains respond to peer pressure.
ex.zh: 该研究考察青少年的大脑如何应对同伴压力。

ex.en: Adolescent behaviour often puzzles parents who have forgotten their own youth.
ex.zh: 青春期的行为常常让忘记了自己年轻岁月的父母感到困惑。

phrases.p: adopt an optimistic view of the world

adopt.usage: adapt 适应；adopt 采纳；adopt 采纳意见风俗；observe 遵守庆祝；reserve 保留；follow 遵守先例；反义 reject；派生 adoption n. 收养；v.收养；采取，采纳，接受； 正式通过；ad（一再地）+opt（选择）→一再给出多种选择，最后“采纳”。；ad（表示“去”）+op

ex.en: Among the most popular: paternity and kinship testing, which adopted children can use to find their biological relatives.
ex.zh: 其中最受欢迎的是父子关系和血缘关系鉴定，这种鉴定可以让被收养的孩子找到他们的生身父母。

ex.en: After going through a series of tests, the couple were finally allowed to adopt the child.
ex.zh: 经过一系列审查后，这对夫妇最终获准收养这个孩子。

ex.en: It can be adopted by researchers in other disciplines.
ex.zh: 它可以被其他学科的研究人员采用。

ex.en: The Republican penned order not only eliminated the strict net neutrality rules the FCC had adopted when it had a Democratic majority in 2015, but rejected the commission's authority to require broadband providers to do much of anything.
ex.zh: 共和党人拟定的一纸规定不仅否定了严苛的网络中立法规［2015年，民主党占多数席位时联邦通信委员会(FCC)通过了这项法规］，而且否决了委员会要求宽带供应商做任何事情的权利。

phrases.p: adoption of a nationwide corporate gender quota
phrases.m: 全国企业采用性别配额

adoption.usage: n.采用，接受；收养，领养；索引p402

ex.en: The rapid adoption of electric buses has cut air pollution in the city center.
ex.zh: 电动公交车的迅速采用减少了市中心的空气污染。

senses: a. 收养的；有收养关系的；移居的
adoptive.usage: adj.采用的；有收养关系的；索引p402

ex.en: The adoptive parents spent years preparing for the adoption process.
ex.zh: 养父母花了数年时间准备收养事宜。

ex.en: Studies show that adoptive children can form attachments as strong as biological ones.
ex.zh: 研究表明，养子女能形成与亲生子女同样牢固的依恋。

ex.en: After emigrating, he regarded Canada as his adoptive country.
ex.zh: 移居国外后，他把加拿大当作了自己的移居国。

senses: v. 崇拜，爱慕；喜爱，热爱
adore.usage: 派生adoration n.热爱,爱慕;adoring adj.表示爱慕的；联想成core“核心”→一般大家非常“崇拜”的人都是某个领域的核心人物→崇拜，爱煞。

ex.en: She adores working with children.
ex.zh: 她热爱参与儿童工作。

ex.en: The children adore their grandfather and listen to his stories for hours.
ex.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢祖父，能一连几个小时听他讲故事。

ex.en: Fans adore the singer not only for her voice but for her generosity.
ex.zh: 歌迷们喜爱这位歌手，不仅因为她的嗓音，还因为她的慷慨。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The museum displays jewellery once worn as adornment by wealthy families.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出曾是富裕家庭饰物的珠宝首饰。

ex.en: Children learn languages faster than adults, according to numerous studies.
ex.zh: 大量研究表明，儿童学习语言比成年人快。

ex.en: Many habits formed in childhood persist well into adulthood.
ex.zh: 童年养成的许多习惯会一直延续到成年之后。

advance.usage: in advance 预先，事先；in advance of 在…之前。作形容词时仅作定语。；② n. 进步：scientific advances 科学进步 // social advances 社会进步；索引p402

ex.en: He has known the result in advance. Thus, he is absent from the meeting.
ex.zh: 他已经提前知道结果，所以他没有出席会议。

ex.en: State it overtly, contextualizing your statements so that you're seen not as a disagreeable subordinate but as a colleague who's trying to advance a common objective.
ex.zh: 将你的观点融入到相关背景中公开陈述，这样你就不会被看成一个令人讨厌的下属，而是一个推进一个共同目标的同事。

ex.en: Recent advances in gene technology have doubled the success rate of treatment.
ex.zh: 基因技术的最新进展使治疗成功率提高了一倍。

ex.en: Tickets are much cheaper if you book well in advance.
ex.zh: 如果提前很久订票，票价要便宜得多。

senses: adj. 先进的；高级的；晚期的

phrases.p: use advanced methods of brain scanning
phrases.m: 利用先进的脑部扫描技术

advanced.usage: ① adj. 先进的② adj. 高等的；索引p402

ex.en: The laboratory is equipped with advanced instruments for detecting early cancer.
ex.zh: 实验室配备了用于早期癌症检测的先进仪器。

ex.en: She is taking an advanced course in applied mathematics this term.
ex.zh: 她这学期正在修一门高级应用数学课程。

ex.en: The disease was already at an advanced stage when doctors found it.
ex.zh: 医生发现时，疾病已处于晚期。

ex.en: Rapid technological advancement has transformed the way people work and communicate.
ex.zh: 科技的飞速发展改变了人们工作和交流的方式。

senses: n. (尤指采取某一步骤而带来的)好处,利益
n. 优势；有利条件，有利因素；优点
advantage.usage: have an advantage over sb 比某人有优势。advantageous 为形容词。；拓展：take advantage of 利用；索引p402

ex.en: Each of these systems has its advantages and disadvantages.
ex.zh: 这些系统各有其优缺点。

ex.en: A good command of a foreign language gives applicants a clear advantage.
ex.zh: 熟练掌握一门外语能给求职者带来明显优势。

ex.en: The retailer took full advantage of the fall in shipping costs.
ex.zh: 这家零售商充分利用了运费下降的机会。

ex.en: Being tall is an obvious advantage for a basketball player.
ex.zh: 个子高对篮球运动员来说是明显的优势。

ex.en: It is advantageous to book tickets well in advance during the holiday season.
ex.zh: 在假期旺季提前很久订票是有利的。

senses: n. (尤指不寻常的人或事)出现,到来
n. （重要事件、人物、发明等的）出现，到来

phrases.m: (重要事件、人物、发明等的)出现

ex.en: The advent of the new government resulted in many changes.
ex.zh: 新政府的到来导致了许多变化。

ex.en: The advent of smartphones has fundamentally changed the way people read news.
ex.zh: 智能手机的出现从根本上改变了人们阅读新闻的方式。

ex.en: With the advent of artificial intelligence, many traditional jobs are being redefined.
ex.zh: 随着人工智能的到来，许多传统职业正被重新定义。

senses: n. 冒险,惊险活动(c);奇遇
n. 冒险，冒险经历；奇遇
adventure.usage: 辨析:有生命或经济风险用venture;寻求刺激的冒险用adventure;派生adventurer冒险家

ex.en: The novel describes a young sailor's adventures on the high seas.
ex.zh: 这部小说讲述了一位年轻水手在公海上的冒险经历。

ex.en: For many students, studying overseas is an exciting adventure.
ex.zh: 对许多学生来说，出国留学是一场令人兴奋的冒险。

ex.en: He sought adventure rather than a comfortable and predictable life.
ex.zh: 他追求的是冒险，而不是舒适而可预见的生活。

ex.en: Critics accused the government of dangerous military adventurism overseas.
ex.zh: 批评者指责政府在海外奉行危险的军事冒险主义。

ex.en: The gap year encourages students to be adventurous and independent.
ex.zh: 间隔年鼓励学生富有冒险精神并学会独立。

ex.en: In the sentence "She sings beautifully," the word "beautifully" is an adverb.
ex.zh: 在句子"她唱得很动听"中，"beautifully"一词是副词。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: The two firms once had an adversarial relationship but now cooperate on research.
ex.zh: 这两家公司曾是敌对关系，如今在研究方面展开合作。

senses: a. 不利的；有害的；反面的
adverse.usage: be adverse to 与…相反。；同义hostile,unfriendly,harmful;反义favorable;去d即averse(反对的)；索引p402

ex.en: The drug may cause adverse reactions in some patients.
ex.zh: 这种药物可能会在某些患者身上引起不良反应。

ex.en: Adverse weather conditions forced the airline to cancel dozens of flights.
ex.zh: 恶劣的天气状况迫使航空公司取消了数十个航班。

ex.en: Despite adverse circumstances, the small firm managed to survive the recession.
ex.zh: 尽管环境不利，这家小公司仍在衰退中幸存下来。

senses: v. 做广告,登广告宣传
advertise.usage: 派生advertising n.广告业;advertisement n.广告;advertiser n.刊登广告者

ex.en: Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals.
ex.zh: 抹润肤霜被广告宣传为早晨美容程序的一部分。

ex.en: The firm plans to advertise its new product on television and social media.
ex.zh: 这家公司计划在电视和社交媒体上为新产品做广告。

ex.en: The school advertised for a part-time physics teacher in the local press.
ex.zh: 学校在当地报刊上登广告招聘一名兼职物理教师。

ex.en: Do not advertise the fact that your flat will be empty for a month.
ex.zh: 不要声张你的公寓将有一个月没人住。

ex.en: Skin moisturizers are advertised as part of morning beauty rituals, slipped in between hair brushing and putting on makeup.
ex.zh: 皮肤保湿霜被宣传为早晨美容仪式的一部分，在梳头和化妆之间(的时段)涂抹。

advertisement.usage: n.广告；an online advertisement 在线广告；索引p402

ex.en: The job advertisement attracted thousands of applicants within a week.
ex.zh: 这则招聘广告在一周内吸引了数千名申请者。

ex.en: She saw an advertisement for cheap flights to Rome in yesterday's paper.
ex.zh: 她在昨天的报纸上看到一则罗马廉价航班的广告。

ex.en: Critics complain that an advertisement interrupts the programme every ten minutes.
ex.zh: 批评者抱怨每十分钟就有一条广告打断节目。

senses: n. 广告商；广告人员；广告公司；登广告者

ex.en: It is not yet clear how advertisers will respond.
ex.zh: 广告商会如何回应尚不清楚。

ex.en: Advertisers are shifting their budgets from television to social media platforms.
ex.zh: 广告商正把预算从电视转移到社交媒体平台。

ex.en: Advertisers must not make exaggerated claims about the effectiveness of a product.
ex.zh: 广告商不得对产品功效做出夸大宣传。

senses: n. 做广告；广告活动；广告业

phrases.m: 对广告实施严格的限制

ex.en: Online advertising now earns more revenue than print media in many countries.
ex.zh: 在许多国家，在线广告目前的收入已超过平面媒体。

ex.en: On my teacher's advice, I spent a year abroad to improve my language skills.
ex.zh: 听从老师的建议，我出国一年以提高语言能力。

ex.en: The report offers practical advice on how small firms can cut energy costs.
ex.zh: 报告就小企业如何削减能源成本提供了切实可行的建议。

ex.en: Take my advice and read the contract carefully before signing it.
ex.zh: 听我的劝告，签字之前仔细读一读合同。

advisable.usage: It is advisable to do sth 做某事是明智的。；用法:常用于It is advisable that...句型,该句型的that从句须用虚拟语气；adj.明智的，可取的；索引p402

ex.en: It is advisable to save money for your children.
ex.zh: 为你的孩子省点钱是很明智的。

ex.en: When you are making complex decisions, it is advisable to follow your feelings.
ex.zh: 当你在做复杂的决定时，遵从你的感觉是明智的。

ex.en: It is advisable to check the contract carefully before signing any long-term agreement.
ex.zh: 在签署任何长期协议之前仔细核对合同是明智的。

advise.usage: v.通知，告知；劝告，建议；索引p402

ex.en: Doctors advise patients to exercise for at least half an hour each day.
ex.zh: 医生建议病人每天至少锻炼半小时。

ex.en: The bank advised us that interest rates would rise early next year.
ex.zh: 银行通知我们明年初利率将上调。

ex.en: Officials strongly advise against travel to the region during the flood season.
ex.zh: 官员们强烈建议汛期不要前往该地区旅行。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 顾问的,咨询的,劝告的

ex.en: She serves on an advisory committee that reviews food safety standards.
ex.zh: 她在一家审查食品安全标准的顾问委员会任职。

ex.en: The weather service issued a travel advisory ahead of the storm.
ex.zh: 气象部门在暴风雨来临前发布了出行警报。

ex.en: The professor acted as an advisory member of the research team.
ex.zh: 这位教授担任研究团队的顾问成员。

ex.en: She is well known for her advocacy of stronger consumer protection laws.
ex.zh: 她因倡导加强消费者保护法而广为人知。

advocate.usage: advocate后接that从句时用虚拟语气（should+动词原形）。；后接 doing，不接 to do。近义：promote vt. 促进；提倡；v.拥护，提倡 n.拥护者，提倡者；辩护律师；advocate doing sth（不接 to do）；作名词重音在第一音节。；词根记忆: ad(表加强)+voc(ca

ex.en: Many experts advocate reforming the tax system.
ex.zh: 许多专家主张改革税收制度。

ex.en: The report also advocates greater study of foreign languages, international affairs and the expansion of study abroad programs.
ex.zh: 报告还提倡更为深入地研究外语、国际事务以及海外留学项目的扩展。

ex.en: Most child psychologists advocate limiting young children's screen time.
ex.zh: 大多数儿童心理学家提倡限制幼儿看屏幕的时间。

ex.en: She is a leading advocate of prison reform in the United States.
ex.zh: 她是美国监狱改革的主要倡导者。

senses: adj. 航空的；空气的；空想的

ex.en: The documentary opens with aerial shots of the island's rugged coastline.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片以该岛崎岖海岸线的航拍镜头开场。

ex.en: The Wright brothers completed the first powered aeroplane flight in 1903.
ex.zh: 莱特兄弟于1903年完成了首次动力飞机飞行。

ex.en: The airplane was delayed for three hours because of heavy fog at the airport.
ex.zh: 由于机场大雾，飞机延误了三个小时。

senses: adj. 美学的,艺术的,审美的
adj. 美学的；审美的；艺术的

ex.en: The design of the building was admired for its aesthetic appeal.
ex.zh: 这座建筑的设计因其美学魅力而受到赞赏。

ex.en: Beyond practical concerns, consumers also consider the aesthetic value of a product.
ex.zh: 除了实用考虑，消费者还会关注产品的审美价值。

ex.en: The museum's aesthetic standards have influenced generations of painters.
ex.zh: 这座博物馆的审美标准影响了几代画家。

senses: n. [C] 事务；事件；风流韵事
n. 事情；[pl.] 事务；风流韵事

ex.en: The foreign ministry declined to comment on the internal affairs of its neighbour.
ex.zh: 外交部拒绝就其邻国的内部事务发表评论。

ex.en: The wedding was a quiet family affair, attended by only a dozen guests.
ex.zh: 婚礼只是一场安静的家庭庆典，只有十几位客人出席。

ex.en: Newspapers speculated about the minister's private affair for weeks.
ex.zh: 报界对部长的私情猜测了数周。

senses: vt. 影响；感动；（疾病）侵袭
affect.usage: affect（动词）与effect（名词）区分。；af-(去)+fect(做)→作用于→影响；effect 是名词“效果”，affect 是动词“影响”；infect 的近义词；辨析:affect指影响的后果明显、看得见;influence指看不见摸不着的影响力,尤指思想、言行方面；词根：af(near靠近)+fect

ex.en: More than seven million people have been affected by drought.
ex.zh: 七百多万人受到了干旱的影响。

ex.en: Ferraro wanted to see if Indonesia's poverty-alleviation program was affecting deforestation.
ex.zh: 费拉罗想知道印度尼西亚的扶贫项目是否影响到了森林砍伐。

ex.en: Rising sea levels will affect millions of people living in coastal cities.
ex.zh: 海平面上升将影响生活在沿海城市的数百万人。

ex.en: Lack of sleep can seriously affect a student's memory and concentration.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会严重影响学生的记忆力和注意力。

affection.usage: 辨析:love比affection更强烈,love还可意味着比affection更难控制的感情

ex.en: People of different ages and genders show affection in different ways.
ex.zh: 不同年龄和性别的人表达爱意的方式不同。

ex.en: The old teacher retained a deep affection for his former students.
ex.zh: 这位老教师对从前的学生怀有深厚的感情。

ex.en: Children need affection as much as they need food and shelter.
ex.zh: 孩子对情感的需要与对食物和住所的需要同样重要。

ex.en: Dogs are affectionate animals that form strong bonds with their owners.
ex.zh: 狗是重感情的动物，会与主人建立深厚的感情。

senses: v. 使隶属于；接纳…为成员
v. 使隶属(或附属)于,使成为会员
n. 成员,附属机构,分公司
v. 使隶属，使并入（较大的团体、公司、组织）；加入；与……有关；为……工作
affiliate.usage: af（表示强调）+fil（联想成file“文件”）+i+ate（使）→重要文件附属于分公司→（使）隶属。；索引p402

ex.en: International affiliates account for a fast-growing segment of production in economies that open up and welcome foreign investment.
ex.zh: 在那些开放并欢迎外国投资的经济体中，国际分公司成为（国民）生产中一个快速增长的部分。

ex.en: The research centre is an affiliate of the national university hospital.
ex.zh: 该研究中心是国家大学医院的附属机构。

ex.en: All local clubs must be affiliated to the national sports association.
ex.zh: 所有地方俱乐部都必须隶属于全国体育协会。

ex.en: The parent company and its overseas affiliates employ over forty thousand people.
ex.zh: 母公司及其海外附属机构雇用了四万多名员工。

ex.en: The research centre is affiliated with the national university's medical school.
ex.zh: 该研究中心隶属于这所国立大学的医学院。

senses: n. 附属机构；隶属关系

ex.en: The party's affiliation with the trade unions dates back more than a century.
ex.zh: 该党与工会的联系可以追溯到一个多世纪以前。

senses: vt. (在法庭上)证实,宣誓说实话
v. 确认，证实，断言……属实；申明；坚定（信念或观点）
affirm.usage: af（表示"加强"）+firm（牢固的）→一再地使它牢固→肯定；词根记忆：af(表加强)+firm(strong,坚固的)→使坚固→肯定属实；索引p402

ex.en: The decision was affirmed by the Court of Appeal.
ex.zh: 上诉法院确认了这一决定。

ex.en: "The Heart of the Matter," the just-released report by the American Academy of Arts and Sciences (AAAS), deserves praise for affirming the importance of the humanities and social sciences to the prosperity and security of liberal democracy in America.
ex.zh: 美国人文与科学院(AAAS)刚刚发布的报告《问题的核心》在肯定人文学科和社会科学对于美国自由民主制的繁荣和稳定的重要性方面值得称赞。

ex.en: The survey results affirm what many teachers have long believed about the value of reading aloud.
ex.zh: 调查结果证实了许多教师长期以来对朗读价值的看法。

ex.en: Winning the award was a powerful affirmation of her twenty years of research.
ex.zh: 获得该奖项是对她二十年研究工作的有力肯定。

senses: adj. 丰富的,富裕的,繁荣的
affluent.usage: af(向)+flu(流动)+ent→丰富的,繁荣的;派生affluence n.丰富,富裕；af（表示加强）+flu（流）+ent（形容词后缀）→钱多得向外流→富裕的

ex.en: Sweden is one of affluent countries in the world.
ex.zh: 瑞典是全球富国之一。

ex.en: Affluent families are more likely to invest in private education.
ex.zh: 富裕家庭更有可能在私立教育上投资。

ex.en: The suburb has become one of the most affluent districts in the country.
ex.zh: 这个郊区已成为全国最富裕的地区之一。

senses: vt. 买得起；负担得起；提供
v. 担负得起,买得起,花得起(时间)
afford.usage: 常与can/could/be able to连用。；v.买得起；承担得起；提供， 给予；索引p402

ex.en: Even now that he is working steadily, he said, "I can't afford to pay my monthly mortgage payments on my own, so I have to rent rooms out to people to make that happen."
ex.zh: 即便现在工作稳定，他说："我一个人负担不起房子的月供，所以我必须把房间租给别人，这样才能够支付月供。"

ex.en: Many young families cannot afford to buy a flat in the city centre.
ex.zh: 许多年轻家庭买不起市中心的住房。

ex.en: We cannot afford to ignore the repeated warnings of climate scientists.
ex.zh: 我们承受不起忽视气候科学家反复警告的后果。

ex.en: The new library affords students free access to thousands of journals.
ex.zh: 新图书馆让学生免费查阅数千种期刊。

senses: adj. 负担得起的；价格实惠的
affordable.usage: ①负担得起的例2018年阅读；索引p402

ex.en: Online education can supplement the traditional kind. It could make extra training and instruction affordable.
ex.zh: 在线教育可以成为传统教育的补充，能够让人们负担得起额外的培训和指导。

books.unit: 附录 I 部分国家(或地区)名称及相关信息

ex.en: Afghanistan's rugged mountains have shaped its history and culture for centuries.
ex.zh: 阿富汗崎岖的山脉数百年来塑造了它的历史与文化。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 漂浮;有偿债能力;能维持下去;周转顺畅
adv.（在水上）漂浮；有偿债能力；能维持下去

ex.en: Many papers stayed afloat by pushing journalists overboard.
ex.zh: 很多报社靠辞退记者维持下去。

ex.en: The government loan helped the struggling airline stay afloat.
ex.zh: 政府贷款帮助这家陷入困境的航空公司维持了运营。

ex.en: The wreck remained afloat for hours before sinking.
ex.zh: 失事船只在水上漂浮了数小时才沉没。

ex.en: Some officials are afraid of making decisions that might invite public criticism.
ex.zh: 一些官员害怕做出可能招致公众批评的决定。

africa.usage: 附录Ⅱ 大洲名；形容词 African

ex.en: Africa is the second largest continent, rich in natural resources and cultural traditions.
ex.zh: 非洲是世界第二大洲，自然资源和文化传统都十分丰富。

ex.en: The conference examined the impact of climate change on African agriculture.
ex.zh: 这次会议审查了气候变化对非洲农业的影响。

ex.en: The committee will publish its final report after all the evidence has been reviewed.
ex.zh: 委员会将在审阅所有证据后发布最终报告。

senses: n. (常用单数)(战争、事故、不快事情的)后果,创伤
n. （战争、事故、不快事情等的）后果
aftermath.usage: 易混辨析：尤指战争、事故或者不快事情导致的直接后果或者创伤；索引p402

ex.en: From career to community and family, these contrasts suggest that in the aftermath of the searing Great Recession, those just starting out in life are defining priorities and expectations that will increasingly spread through virtually all aspects of American life, from consumer preferences to housing patterns to politics.
ex.zh: 从事业到社区再到家庭，这些对照差异表明，在经济大衰退余波未了的情况下，那些人生刚刚起步的年轻人正在定义人生首要事项和各种期待，而这些事项和期待将会真正日益贯穿美国人生活的各个方面，从消费喜好到房子的户型，再到政治。

ex.en: The museum is free to visitors on the first Sunday afternoon of each month.
ex.zh: 每月第一个周日下午博物馆对游客免费开放。

ex.en: The lecture was followed by a lively discussion, and afterward many students stayed to ask questions.
ex.zh: 讲座后进行了热烈的讨论，之后许多学生留下来提问。

ex.en: We visited the museum in the morning and went to the botanical garden afterwards.
ex.zh: 我们上午参观了博物馆，之后去了植物园。

ex.en: The root 'ag/act', meaning 'to do', appears in words such as 'agency' and 'activate'.
ex.zh: 词根 ag/act 意为“做”，出现在 agency（代理机构）、activate（激活）等词中。

senses: ad. 再一次；又一次；返回原处；增加

ex.en: The bank apologized for the error and promised that it would never happen again.
ex.zh: 银行对该错误表示道歉，并保证此类事件不再发生。

senses: prep. 反对；倚；碰；撞；以防；和……相比

ex.en: Residents voted against the plan to build a shopping center on the old playground.
ex.zh: 居民们投票反对在旧操场上建造购物中心的计划。

senses: 表总称、行为或行为的结果，名词词性
age.usage: 同义:epoch,era;act one's age举止和年龄相称;of age成年的;派生aged adj.年老的;ag(e)ing n.变老的过程

ex.en: The legal age for buying tobacco will rise from eighteen to twenty-one next year.
ex.zh: 购买烟草的法定年龄明年将从十八岁提高到二十一岁。

ex.en: An ageing population places increasing pressure on pension and health systems.
ex.zh: 人口老龄化给养老金和医疗体系带来越来越大的压力。

senses: n. 代理机构；（政府）机构
n. 服务机构；（尤指）代理机构，经销机构；（政府的）专门机构
agency.usage: agent(代理商)+cy(名词后缀)→代理(处)；n.代理行，经销处

ex.en: She works for an advertising agency.
ex.zh: 她在一家广告公司工作。

ex.en: The environmental agency has published strict new rules on industrial waste.
ex.zh: 环境署公布了关于工业废物的严格新规。

ex.en: He found his current job through a well-known recruitment agency.
ex.zh: 他通过一家知名职业介绍所找到了现在的工作。

ex.en: The travel agency arranged every detail of our study trip to Egypt.
ex.zh: 旅行社安排了我们埃及游学之行的每一个细节。

senses: n. 议程表，议事日程；计划，方案；意图，目的
n. 目的；(会议的)议事日程
agenda.usage: n.待议事项，议事日程；age(年龄)+n+da(大)→年纪大了记性不好，写好议事日程提醒自己；索引p402

ex.en: We have a very full agenda of issues to discuss.
ex.zh: 我们的议程安排很满，有很多议题要讨论。

ex.en: Climate change now sits at the top of the political agenda in most European countries.
ex.zh: 如今，气候变化在大多数欧洲国家都位列政治议程之首。

senses: n. 代理人，经纪人；动因
agent.usage: 发音类似“挨近他”→挨近明星的叫作经纪人或代理人→代理人，经纪人。

ex.en: Now he's living in a council flat and fielding offers from literary agents.
ex.zh: 现在，他住在一个政府出租的公寓里，处理来自文学经纪人的邀约。

ex.en: The writer's agent negotiated a generous contract with the publisher.
ex.zh: 作家的经纪人与出版商谈成了一份报酬丰厚的合同。

ex.en: Agents for the football star confirmed that transfer talks had begun.
ex.zh: 这位足球明星的经纪人证实转会谈判已经开始。

aggravate.usage: ag-（加强）+grav（重）+ate→加重。近义：worsen v. （使）恶化；[记]ag-（加强）+grav（重）+-ate（动词后缀）→加重。[族]aggravation n. 恶化；加剧；派生 aggravation n. 加重，加剧，恶化；v.使加重，使恶化；惹怒，激怒；ag（表示“加强”）+grav（=g

ex.en: Pollution can aggravate asthma.
ex.zh: 污染会使哮喘加重。

ex.en: The guild-like ownership structure is considered "restrictive" partly because it aggravates the ethical situation in the trade.
ex.zh: 这种类似于行业协会的所有制结构被认为是"有限的"，部分原因在于它会使贸易中的道德问题加剧。

ex.en: Cutting public transport services would only aggravate traffic congestion in the city centre.
ex.zh: 削减公共交通服务只会加剧市中心的交通拥堵。

ex.en: The long delay caused considerable aggravation for passengers waiting at the airport.
ex.zh: 长时间的延误令在机场等候的乘客颇为恼火。

senses: adj. (只用于名词前)总数的，总计的
aggregate.usage: 派生 aggregation n. 集成，集结，聚集(体)

ex.en: In aggregate, the small donations from thousands of viewers covered the hospital's entire annual budget.
ex.zh: 总计而言，数千名观众的小额捐款覆盖了医院全年的预算。

ex.en: Data aggregation helps researchers identify patterns across large populations.
ex.zh: 数据聚合帮助研究者从大样本中发现规律。

aggression.usage: n.攻击性；侵略，侵犯， 挑衅

ex.en: Psychologists distinguish between hostile aggression and instrumental aggression.
ex.zh: 心理学家区分了敌意性攻击与工具性攻击。

ex.en: The country's unprovoked aggression against its neighbour was condemned worldwide.
ex.zh: 该国对邻国无端发动的侵略受到了全世界的谴责。

ex.en: Exposure to violent games may increase aggression among children.
ex.zh: 接触暴力游戏可能会增加儿童的攻击性。

senses: adj. 侵略的；好斗的；有进取心的
a. 侵略的；有进取心的
②积极进取的，活跃有为的
adj. 好斗的；侵略的；有闯劲的，有进取心的
aggressive.usage: 同义 combative, offensive, hostile, militant；派生 aggressor n. 侵略者，挑衅者；adj.好斗的，挑衅的；进 取的；ag（表强调）+gress（走）+ive→强调一直走→好胜的；词根记忆: ag(to, 向)+gress(go, 走)+ive→向…步步紧逼→挑衅的→好

ex.en: In those situations, it's better to be more aggressive than less aggressive.
ex.zh: 在那样的情形下，更有进取心要比没有进取心更好。

ex.en: Seals have been known to exhibit aggressive behaviour towards swimmers.
ex.zh: 众所周知，海豹对游泳者表现出攻击性行为。

ex.en: The company adopted an aggressive marketing strategy to win customers from its rivals.
ex.zh: 该公司采取了积极进取的营销策略，从对手那里争取客户。

ex.en: The company has expanded aggressively into overseas markets in recent years.
ex.zh: 近年来，这家公司大举进军海外市场。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: n. 进取精神；侵略性；攻击性

ex.en: Studies link the fish's unusual aggressiveness to the shrinking size of its habitat.
ex.zh: 研究将这种鱼异常的攻击性与其栖息地缩小联系起来。

ex.en: The treaty was designed to protect smaller states against any potential aggressor.
ex.zh: 该条约旨在保护小国免受任何潜在侵略者的侵害。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: adj. 机敏的,机灵的;敏捷的,灵活的

ex.en: Small firms are often more agile than large corporations when the market shifts.
ex.zh: 市场生变时，小公司往往比大企业反应更灵活。

senses: v. 煽动，鼓动；激怒，使不安
agitate.usage: 同义 excite, provoke, stir up；反义 calm 使平静；派生 agitated 激动的，狂躁不安的；agitation n. 激动，不安，焦虑；发音类似“爱激他的”。你总是爱“激怒”他。；索引p402

ex.en: Executives were violently agitated.
ex.zh: 高管们非常激动。

ex.en: Workers agitated for shorter hours and higher pay throughout the spring.
ex.zh: 整个春天，工人们都在鼓动争取更短的工时和更高的工资。

ex.en: Do not agitate the bottle before measuring the liquid's temperature.
ex.zh: 测量液体温度之前不要摇动瓶子。

ex.en: She was deeply agitated by the news of her father's accident.
ex.zh: 父亲出事的消息使她深感不安。

ex.en: Constant news alerts can cause agitation and weaken one's ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 接连不断的新闻推送会引发焦躁情绪，削弱人的专注力。

ex.en: The manuscript was discovered in a library basement more than a century ago.
ex.zh: 这份手稿是一个多世纪前在图书馆地下室里被发现的。

ex.en: The family faced an agonizing wait for news of the missing climbers.
ex.zh: 全家人痛苦地等待着失踪登山者的消息。

senses: n. [U,C] （精神或肉体的）极度痛苦
agony.usage: 记：agon（痛苦）+-y（名词后缀）→痛苦到极点的状态→极度痛苦；a（发音类似“爱”）+go（发音类似“过”）+ny（发音类似“你”）→曾经爱过你，现在一想起来就十分痛苦→极大的痛苦。；索引p402

ex.en: Modern medicine has prolonged the physical agony of dying.
ex.zh: 现代医学延长了临终前肉体的痛苦。

ex.en: The wounded climber lay in agony until the rescue team arrived at dawn.
ex.zh: 受伤的登山者痛苦地躺着，直到拂晓救援队赶到。

ex.en: She went through the agony of waiting two weeks for the test results.
ex.zh: 她饱受两周等待检查结果的煎熬。

ex.en: For many patients, the new drug relieves the agony of chronic back pain.
ex.zh: 对许多病人来说，这种新药能减轻慢性背痛的巨大痛苦。

agree.usage: agree with还可表示食物适合或气候适宜。；辨：agree普通用词；consent着重意愿或感情、常和to连用；approve作不及物动词时常与of连用；索引p402

ex.en: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
ex.zh: 议会还同意取缔那些通过宣扬极端节食而"鼓吹过度纤瘦"的网站。

ex.en: Most economists agree that automation will reshape the labour market.
ex.zh: 大多数经济学家一致认为，自动化将重塑劳动力市场。

ex.en: The two sides finally agreed on a date for further negotiations.
ex.zh: 双方最终就进一步谈判的日期达成了一致。

senses: adj. 令人愉快的；欣然同意的
adj. 可以接受的；令人愉快的
agreeable.usage: 辨析：agreeable 指与某人气质、爱好、感情相合而使人愉快；pleasant 指人或事物因其令人高兴的外表或言行而令人愉快；索引p402

ex.en: The weather in early autumn is agreeable for outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 初秋的天气宜人，适合户外活动。

ex.en: She was perfectly agreeable to postponing the meeting until Friday.
ex.zh: 她非常乐意把会议推迟到星期五。

ex.en: An agreeable working environment can significantly raise employees' productivity.
ex.zh: 令人愉快的工作环境能显著提高员工的生产率。

senses: n. 协定；（意见或看法）一致

ex.en: After months of negotiation, the two companies finally signed a trade agreement.
ex.zh: 经过数月谈判，两家公司终于签署了贸易协议。

ex.en: Modern agricultural techniques have sharply increased crop yields.
ex.zh: 现代农业技术大幅提高了农作物产量。

ex.en: The country's economy still depends heavily on agricultural exports.
ex.zh: 该国经济仍在很大程度上依赖农产品出口。

ex.en: Agriculture still employs more than half of the region's workforce.
ex.zh: 农业仍然雇用着该地区一半以上的劳动力。

ex.en: The government subsidizes agriculture to keep domestic food prices stable.
ex.zh: 政府补贴农业以保持国内粮价稳定。

ex.en: Modern agriculture depends heavily on machinery, fertilizers and reliable weather data.
ex.zh: 现代农业严重依赖机械、化肥和可靠的气象数据。

ex.en: The region's agro-technological innovation has dramatically raised crop yields.
ex.zh: 该地区的农业技术创新大幅提高了农作物产量。

ex.en: The road ahead is closed for repairs, so drivers must take the northern route.
ex.zh: 前方道路因维修封闭，司机必须走北线。

aid.usage: 另 aid sb. with sth. 用某物帮助某人

ex.en: International aid reached the flooded villages within days of the disaster.
ex.zh: 灾难发生后数天内，国际援助物资就抵达了被淹的村庄。

senses: vt.&vi. 瞄准；对准；力求达到

phrases.m: 把批评的矛头指向某人或某事物

aim.usage: n.目标，目的 v.瞄准，对准；旨在，致力于；②vi.针对(2018年翻译):Plays aiming at literary distinction were written for schools or court, or for the choir boys of St. Paul's and the royal

ex.en: The state's proposed Forest Carbon Plan aims to double efforts to thin out young trees and clear brush in parts of the forest.
ex.zh: 该州提出的“森林碳计划”旨在加倍努力给幼树间苗并清理森林中部分区域的灌木丛。

ex.en: The aim of the policy is to cut youth unemployment by half within five years.
ex.zh: 该政策的目标是在五年内将青年失业率减半。

ex.en: The new rules aim at protecting consumers from hidden charges.
ex.zh: 新规定旨在保护消费者免受隐性收费。

ex.en: The programme aims to help one hundred thousand jobless workers gain new skills each year.
ex.zh: 该计划旨在每年帮助十万名失业工人掌握新技能。

ex.en: The ending '-ain' appears in nouns denoting people, such as 'captain' and 'villain'.
ex.zh: 词尾 -ain 出现在 captain（船长）、villain（恶棍）等表示人的名词中。

senses: v. 使通风,使晾干,使公开

ex.en: Strict emission controls have significantly improved the air in industrial cities.
ex.zh: 严格的排放管制显著改善了工业城市的空气。

senses: n. 空气调节系统,空调

ex.en: The office installed air-conditioning to keep staff comfortable during heatwaves.
ex.zh: 办公室安装了空调，以便在热浪来袭时让员工保持舒适。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

senses: a. 空中的；空降的；空气传播的
adj. 升空的,飞行中的;空气传播的;空降的
adj. (飞行器)在空中的；空气传播的；空降的

ex.en: The virus can remain airborne for several hours in enclosed spaces.
ex.zh: 这种病毒在封闭空间内可在空气中悬浮数小时。

ex.en: The aircraft was airborne within minutes after the emergency call.
ex.zh: 接到紧急呼叫后几分钟，飞机便升空了。

ex.en: Airborne pollen levels peak in late spring, aggravating hay fever.
ex.zh: 空气中的花粉浓度在春末达到峰值，加重了花粉热。

aircraft.usage: 单复数同形。；助记:air(空中)+craft(ship船)→空中的船→航空器；索引p402

ex.en: The airline has ordered twenty new aircraft to meet growing demand.
ex.zh: 该航空公司已订购二十架新飞机以满足日益增长的需求。

ex.en: Radar detected an unidentified aircraft approaching the coastline.
ex.zh: 雷达探测到一架不明飞行器正在接近海岸线。

ex.en: Engineers are developing lighter materials to reduce aircraft weight.
ex.zh: 工程师们正在研发更轻的材料以减轻飞机重量。

books.unit: 历年真题重点超纲词系统归类

ex.en: Good airflow inside buildings can reduce the spread of airborne diseases.
ex.zh: 建筑物内良好的通风气流能减少呼吸道疾病的传播。
